We are in the closing days of this campaign – and the closing moments of our final end-of-month fundraising deadline.
You already know that democracy is on the line. But if we can come together and dig deep, we can not only win this campaign, we can ensure our freedoms will be protected from the dangerous forces trying to unravel our democracy.
So please, rush a donation of any amount before midnight tonight. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/schultz-october-2024?refcode=20241031.2]
Thank you,
Jen

Hi friends,
By now, you’ve probably heard about the “little secret” Trump has with Mike Johnson...
“With our little secret we’re going to do really well with
the House, right? [Johnson] and I have a secret.
We’ll tell you what it is when the race is over.”
— Donald Trump
They might be referencing a refusal to certify the results of the election if Kamala Harris wins next week. ANY attempt to overrule the will of the voters is unconstitutional and unAmerican–no matter who it is that wins.
While Republicans across the country bend the knee to Donald Trump again, Democratic candidates are putting Constitution before party. We can stop these threats to overthrow our democracy by flipping the House to Democratic control. The one way we can guarantee that happening?
By electing Jen Schultz here in Minnesota’s 8th!

| Team —

You will never get that fake urgency from me.

Real needs, because we are seeing our margin in public polls start to tighten, and our opponent is trumpeting that his campaign’s internal polls show a tied race.

**From the bottom of my heart, thank you, Peter.**
You’ve been with me every step of the way, so I’m hoping you’ll chip in one more grassroots contribution to help us meet our October goal before midnight tonight.

name: OKGOP
subject: Day 3 of Early Voting is tomorrow…here are the three things you need to know!
body:
| [ ](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=urG6o0YzHACIJY0G92IOaIOiUFGhm1XQHaiZ59fvCoY&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_day_3_of_early_voting_is_tom&n=1)
---
Peter, Friday November 1st marks the 3rd day of early voting here in Oklahoma. So what are the three things you need to know? First of all, there just so happen to be 3 judges of the Oklahoma Supreme Court on the ballot. And they are ALL liberal. They are all THREE appointed by Democrat Governors. And we have the chance to remove all three at once. If WE vote NO on all three liberal Supreme Court judges, they will be removed and can no longer be able to force their liberal agenda on Oklahoma. The question on your ballot will be if Edmonson, Gurich, & Kauger should be retained in their current positions. And the answer is NO, they should not be retained. All three must go, so we must all VOTE NO! Secondly, you’ll be voting on several candidates beyond just the President. We can all compare the economic boom with 4 years of President Trump to the disastrous 4 years under Biden-Harris. If your mind isn’t already made up on who to vote for as President think of how much better off you were 4 years ago & realize we can have that again. There are other candidates on the ballot, so the easiest way to vote is to choose “Republican” straight party voting. That’ll make your selection for all those races & help put in Republicans at the State & local level to help restore our economy & keep more money in your pockets. And third, you’ll also have two State Questions on your ballot. SQ833 creates new tax structures. Many people are torn on how to vote for this, but we’ll just put out there that we don’t believe the government needs MORE ways to tax us. If you agree we don’t need more tax options, you’ll vote no on this one. As for SQ834 it would clarify that ONLY citizens can vote in Oklahoma elections. It’s obvious part of the Biden-Harris open border plan is to get more people voting, including non-citizens. In fact a dozen cities already allow non-citizens to vote INCLUDING Washington DC! We must secure our elections by allowing ONLY citizens to vote. Otherwise liberal court judges (refer to the first item listed above!) will allow law-breaking foreigners to vote in our elections. So there you have it, the three things you need to know. 1) Vote no on all THREE Supreme Court judges. 2) Vote Republican straight party. 3) On the State Questions vote for lower taxes & ONLY citizens voting. -Team OKGOP

You can also keep up with OKGOP on [Twitter](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=JcrYNQ7dhdufXPgOgJxNGHSsRONv6mnq7ly6aBOUvGVprSj7jfHNOpP70kR_1QLA&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_day_3_of_early_voting_is_tom&n=3) or [Facebook](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=UQNagEd-DqbIXa37T8ODid9mG9NGbq3z9te4_riKc6EaGmrOrRzKc2wAaVTFbzRY&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_day_3_of_early_voting_is_tom&n=4).

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

name: Jill Stein
subject: Trump didn’t drain the swamp - he filled it
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=trump_swamp&n=1)
---
Peter,

In 2016 Donald Trump duped millions of voters into believing he would go to Washington and drive out corruption.

_“Draining the swamp,”_ he called it.

In that election Trump positioned himself as the anti-establishment candidate. And up against Hillary Clinton, to the casual voter it was a somewhat convincing argument.

But the moment he took office, Trump filled his cabinet and every federal agency with cronies, crooks, lackeys, and lobbyists – to the tune of HUNDREDS of key positions according to a 2018 _ProPublica_ analysis.

The result was the mass auctioning off of public parks and sacred native land for drilling, mining, and exploitation; a scam tax bill that shuffled BILLIONS in wealth directly to Trump’s own pockets and those of his elite buddies; empty promises on healthcare; foreign policy moves that directly undermined global peace and security (and directly profited Donald Trump); and a criminally mismanaged public health crisis that led to more than a MILLION American deaths.

In 2016 Trump promised that he had a healthcare plan that was “going to cover everybody.” That was a lie.

Donald Trump _never_ had a plan for universal healthcare any more than the Democrats have. Even in last month’s debate he admitted he only had “concepts of a plan” – and one of those “concepts” includes putting known conspiracy theorist RFK Jr. in charge of public health (as a medical doctor, I can assure you that RFK Jr. is _not_ an authority on public health).

If Donald Trump or Kamala Harris want to see what a _real_ healthcare plan looks like, [**they’ll find lots of good ideas in ours**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/healthcare?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=trump_swamp&n=2)**.

**[**And if YOU want a president with an actual, detailed plan for people, planet, and peace, then donate to our movement now for the final push. Every dollar you give helps us reach one more voter on the fence.**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=trump_swamp&n=3)
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=trump_swamp&n=4 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=trump_swamp&n=4)
---
It’s important that we don’t let any of our allies fall prey to Trump’s sloppy, self-serving lies. I’ve called out his corruption and incompetence for years.

I will keep doing so until this public menace is driven out of power for good.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=trump_swamp&n=5)
---
The truth is that Donald Trump DOES have a plan – one that will enrich himself and exploit everyone else.

Donald Trump was born into the establishment. He has skated through life on the privileges of the establishment. It comes as no surprise then, that as president Donald Trump ruled as a firm fixture of the establishment.

He is a product of the society we built, and it won’t change until we build a NEW society rooted in justice, peace, and human thriving.

_That’s_ what this campaign is about. That is the vision we must deliver on November 5th.

In solidarity and gratitude,

clean_body: | | | Peter, In 2016 Donald Trump duped millions of voters into believing he would go to Washington and drive out corruption. “Draining the swamp,” he called it. In that election Trump positioned himself as the anti-establishment candidate. And up against Hillary Clinton, to the casual voter it was a somewhat convincing argument. But the moment he took office, Trump filled his cabinet and every federal agency with cronies, crooks, lackeys, and lobbyists – to the tune of HUNDREDS of key positions according to a 2018 ProPublica analysis. The result was the mass auctioning off of public parks and sacred native land for drilling, mining, and exploitation; a scam tax bill that shuffled BILLIONS in wealth directly to Trump’s own pockets and those of his elite buddies; empty promises on healthcare; foreign policy moves that directly undermined global peace and security (and directly profited Donald Trump); and a criminally mismanaged public health crisis that led to more than a MILLION American deaths. In 2016 Trump promised that he had a healthcare plan that was “going to cover everybody.” That was a lie. Donald Trump never had a plan for universal healthcare any more than the Democrats have. Even in last month’s debate he admitted he only had “concepts of a plan” – and one of those “concepts” includes putting known conspiracy theorist RFK Jr. in charge of public health (as a medical doctor, I can assure you that RFK Jr. is not an authority on public health). Fellow Patriot,

**At West Point, we had a code: cadets don't lie, cheat, steal, or tolerate those who do.**

_First the New York Times lied about my childhood and family, and now CNN is lying about my business record._

And what's worse, they are doing it all because _I 'm within striking distance of an entrenched career politician, Bob Casey, in the #1 swing state in the nation that will determine control of the U.S Senate._

**Bob Casey is getting Leftist news sources to do his dirty work, and I WON 'T TOLERATE IT.

Here's the truth: this is a long message and I hope you will read all the way to the end.**

I grew up in Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania. We lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road.

I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms.

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=380edb0b2d3a4e4fa8f333a59513bef3&_e=t09jTnzdbsmJQxGUAtZO1TjmTGcP5WEapZS-gZMDvSpFAmpbC1abTlTfTVs7crqOrpDJ1uXmrS0_1GQeCb_xz4qo9vW94FnxlrgLUi3kieEHdydRYUFoesnZrfCHQu_eMvWLD31C4w9QVm8DUeuNCDwW9RaNGQ8d6kti2zZYBEHchmzugyrSWjGLk5ZCl_bsCl-TFDEhP7VAlqFpnspKhbmviH_9FnsX-b0wfecD4dtIfgrXW7FHheiaQcvnIHwK2uj0LYlqn37Q3rOTp_mLeEZvIGldA4uku7Q8wWAAPrhO1Cdv-WNBuL6whkRM3ZwH9CtQopWshIdoSj-NAh7U3Sw68oQkps2xyHN5uzk72y8xPX5r8VFWico4Oi4UVkvVK1gJnNOFV4Cnr7WgZrUZrgLXYF5QNJHxKe3LN7955ng%3D)

And it was there that I came home to a parade after serving in combat during the Gulf War.

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=380edb0b2d3a4e4fa8f333a59513bef3&_e=t09jTnzdbsmJQxGUAtZO1TjmTGcP5WEapZS-gZMDvSpFAmpbC1abTlTfTVs7crqOrpDJ1uXmrS0_1GQeCb_xz4qo9vW94FnxlrgLUi3kieEHdydRYUFoesnZrfCHQu_eMvWLD31C4w9QVm8DUeuNCDwW9RaNGQ8d6kti2zZYBEHchmzugyrSWjGLk5ZCl_bsCl-TFDEhP7VAlqFpnspKhbmviH_9FnsX-b0wfecD4dtIfgrXW7FHheiaQcvnIHwK2uj0LYlqn37Q3rOTp_mLeLpNFep_CF2MpqeEiFvFK4kF80GnM9tOzeZI23fy-ElnlLq9mLN6jzLns5p8nb-KkSrzDJQj7WfR6-gCl0dWPVvCzmxSGtX5aViwyR8FzOF62sAcr27a5_h4kDKXpSgTQf8lc3Wq4wYkwgzW-bOPVEY%3D)

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=380edb0b2d3a4e4fa8f333a59513bef3&_e=t09jTnzdbsmJQxGUAtZO1TjmTGcP5WEapZS-gZMDvSpFAmpbC1abTlTfTVs7crqOrpDJ1uXmrS0_1GQeCb_xz4qo9vW94FnxlrgLUi3kieEHdydRYUFoesnZrfCHQu_eMvWLD31C4w9QVm8DUeuNCDwW9RaNGQ8d6kti2zZYBEHchmzugyrSWjGLk5ZCl_bsCl-TFDEhP7VAlqFpnspKhbmviH_9FnsX-b0wfecD4dtIfgrXW7FHheiaQcvnIHwK2uj0LYlqn37Q3rOTp_mLeMRVQRD5UEZ23IVhme_PksKymlMinJA-VbbfNXnn2uAQjpxLEX0kqCAWuKArg3PYjkpXYManxKAIfK_xVSpw6Svt9YIXboIMi9HcrPNxFL_x3s5-pRHo79j3_KW0BtpGDIgo-3HyPZ9q1GFvxBheKuE%3D)

**Nella Domenici**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Friends,
👻 Happy Halloween! 🎃
I’ve got a really scary story to tell you in just a moment, but before I do that:
We are SO CLOSE to our fundraising goal tonight, we’re only $2,450 behind. Can you rush a $31 donation RIGHT NOW to close the gap so we can FIRE JIM JORDAN? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241031_scary_jordan_link1]
Now...for a real hair-raising tale...
Tonight may be full of spooky costumes and haunted houses, but nothing sends a chill down my spine more than the thought of Jim Jordan clinging to power for two more years.
Especially if the GOP holds the House and he gets his hands on the Speaker’s gavel.
His conspiracy-driven extremist agenda would create a living nightmare for the country and if his last 17 years in Congress haven’t been scary enough, just wait – this time, he’s doubling down.
He’s openly said he’d do whatever it takes to keep Trump in power and we should take him at his word.
Don’t want to face another terrifying 2 years of Jim Jordan? Contribute to our campaign today and join the team sending him packing for good. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241031_scary_jordan_link2]
Let’s be real – Jordan’s out there collecting conspiracy theories and controversies faster than kids grabbing candy tonight.
He knows we have him on the ropes and that’s why all of the sudden he’s put on his costume as “public servant” and has started showing up in the district to campaign.
So this Halloween, instead of fake frights, let’s focus on the real nightmare: what Jim Jordan would do with another term in Congress.
More attacks on healthcare and women’s rights, more sham trials, more harm to veterans, farmers, and seniors. It means two more years of division, chaos and dysfunction – and unending loyalty to Trump’s schemes.
Contribute $31 (for October 31!) if you’re ready to put an end to Jim Jordan’s reign of terror. Every dollar goes toward keeping him out of Congress and ending his ULTRA-MAGA madness. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241031_scary_jordan_link2&amount=31]
This is the most important congressional race in the country, and together, we’re going to make sure Jim Jordan’s tricks finally come to an end.
Let’s bring a little light to Ohio this Halloween and make this the last scary election he’s part of!
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

In 5 days, Nevada will decide who they want as their next U.S. senator and their next president.
Ultimately, this election is about two different visions for our nation. One focused on the _future_. And one focused on the _past_.
**Jacky Rosen and I believe in a future where every person has the opportunity not just to get by, but to get ahead.**
Where no child has to grow up in poverty. Where every worker has the freedom to join a union. Where every person has affordable health care, child care, and paid leave. Where every senior can retire with dignity.
**But Donald Trump and his extremist Republican allies want to take our country backward.** They intend to cut Social Security and Medicare, to give tax breaks to billionaires and big corporations and to make working families foot the bill, and end the Affordable Care Act.
_America has tried these failed policies before. We are not going back._
Generations of Americans before us led the fight for freedom. _Now, the baton is in our hands._ To protect the right to vote. To get assault weapons off of our streets. To restore reproductive freedom, reversing Donald Trump's extreme abortion bans.

subject: Friday Symposium: Celebrate the American Revolution!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sare for Senate
body:
| | [](https://www.sareforsenate.com/?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20241101_symposium&n=1)
---
Friend -- Join our symposium dialogue this Friday night, which will discuss the 250th anniversary of the American Revolution. I will be joined in this dialogue by candidate Jose Vega and LaRouche Manhattan Project spokesman, Dennis Speed. What better way to wrap up the 2024 election than to discuss the goals of the American Revolution as our road map for the future! The formal beginning of the Revolution's 250th anniversary is April 19, 2025, in recognition of the "shot heard round the world" -- the Battles of Lexington and Concord of 1775. The celebration will continue through the July 4, 1776 signing of of the Declaration of Independence, the 1783 conclusion of the war of independence's eight years of sacrifice and determination, and the 1788 ratification of the American Constitution. The extraordinary success of the Revolution was a fulfillment of centuries of yearning for the liberation from oligarchy. There was a long history before the first shots were fired -- from Solon of Athens [c. 630 – c. 560 BC], through Nicholas of Cusa [1433, "consent of the governed"], through Gottfried Leibniz [1693 \-- "the entire natural law is derived from the human necessity to pursue happiness understood broadly as the obligation to grow in moral perfection"], and on. The Revolution was supported in its day by Schiller, Beethoven, Mozart, and Ben Franklin's international network of scientists. The disastrous wars and resulting economic hardship faced by Americans today show that the ideas of the British Empire have remained a corrupting and dominant influence in American policy. The revolution is not yet done. Join us Friday night to consider: What does it mean to "declare independence?"

clean_body: | | Friend -- Join our symposium dialogue this Friday night, which will discuss the 250th anniversary of the American Revolution. I will be joined in this dialogue by candidate Jose Vega and LaRouche Manhattan Project spokesman, Dennis Speed. What better way to wrap up the 2024 election than to discuss the goals of the American Revolution as our road map for the future! The formal beginning of the Revolution's 250th anniversary is April 19, 2025, in recognition of the "shot heard round the world" -- the Battles of Lexington and Concord of 1775. The celebration will continue through the July 4, 1776 signing of of the Declaration of Independence, the 1783 conclusion of the war of independence's eight years of sacrifice and determination, and the 1788 ratification of the American Constitution. The extraordinary success of the Revolution was a fulfillment of centuries of yearning for the liberation from oligarchy. There was a long history before the first shots were fired -- from Solon of Athens [c. 630 – c. 560 BC], through Nicholas of Cusa [1433, "consent of the governed"], through Gottfried Leibniz [1693 \-- "the entire natural law is derived from the human necessity to pursue happiness understood broadly as the obligation to grow in moral perfection"], and on. The Revolution was supported in its day by Schiller, Beethoven, Mozart, and Ben Franklin's international network of scientists. The disastrous wars and resulting economic hardship faced by Americans today show that the ideas of the British Empire have remained a corrupting and dominant influence in American policy. The revolution is not yet done. Join us Friday night to consider: What does it mean to "declare independence?" \--Diane Sare * | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- | Paid for by Sare for Senate

clean_body: | | | Peter, I have a big favor to ask: Last time around, Ted Cruz won his race by just over 2% of the vote – that was a difference of about 215,000 votes, Peter. I remember how it felt watching the results roll in on November 6, 2018, and let me tell you, it was a nail-biter. I have no doubts that this year will be when we finally send Ted Cruz packing. But despite being closer than ever to defeating Ted, we've still got a lot more work to do and only a handful of days left to do it. I know seeing a number like $3 million can feel overwhelming, but if thousands of hardworking folks like you chip in $5 here, $25 there, and the occasional $100, we will be able to collectively reach this critical goal. I hope you're having a fun and cozy night. I don't want to interrupt the festivities, so I'll make this quick. With Election Day around the corner, _right now_ is the most critical time to surge support for EMILYs List women up and down the ballot. Let me explain:

Over the past month, I've been on the ground in Michigan, Arizona, Nevada, and a few other key states. I've talked to voters, candidates, and volunteers all across the country. And I can tell you firsthand that the polls and the pundits are right: our women's races will be _close_.

There's a saying in politics, beloved by fundraisers and field organizers alike:**the margin of effort.** When the polls are tight, and a race could go either way, what matters most is the heart, grit, and commitment of the supporters. If we put in the work, we'll win. If we don't, we won't. It's that simple.

Critical races like **VP Kamala Harris', Sen. Tammy Baldwin's (WI-SEN), and Rep. Susan Wild's (PA-07)** now fall squarely within the margin of effort. And your support can help make sure we reach as many voters as possible before Nov. 5. [**Let's give it all we've got, Peter. clean_body: Let me explain what that means: | = Happy Halloween, Peter! I hope you're having a fun and cozy night. I don't want to interrupt the festivities, so I'll make this quick. With Election Day around the corner, right now is the most critical time to surge support for EMILYs List women up and down the ballot. Let me explain: Over the past month, I've been on the ground in Michigan, Arizona, Nevada, and a few other key states. I've talked to voters, candidates, and volunteers all across the country. And I can tell you firsthand that the polls and the pundits are right: our women's races will be close. There's a saying in politics, beloved by fundraisers and field organizers alike:the margin of effort. When the polls are tight, and a race could go either way, what matters most is the heart, grit, and commitment of the supporters. If we put in the work, we'll win. If we don't, we won't. It's that simple. Critical races like VP Kamala Harris', Sen. Tammy Baldwin's (WI-SEN), and Rep. Susan Wild's (PA-07) now fall squarely within the margin of effort. Peter,

I was just boots on the ground at the border in New Mexico, once again assessing the situation and reminding voters just _how bad_ Kamala Harris and Martin Heinrich have allowed it to become.

_Of course, “bad” is the understatement of the century._ Words and phrases like “horrifying,” “deadly,” and “worst in history” get closer to appropriate descriptions of what has happened under their watch.

And it’s not like they just _allowed_ it to happen – **they curated this disaster!**

There’s **NO WAY** we can allow Harris or Heinrich to continue failing us in Washington, D.C., and I need your help to defeat them and their radical agenda here in New Mexico.

**I am ready to get to work on DAY ONE with Pres. Trump to secure our borders and fix what the left has broken.**

We’re so close to the finish line, and I need your help to get across.

Thank you,

**Nella Domenici**

[ ** Help Elect Nella and Secure the Border » **](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=ea42f034c72f4e91970464b0519ccfdc&_e=6vzZDkXE7o6P9yMqC4sBD0sO17cH-woJ2B6t4HD9d6KUuAWca-MJSQEI-iRVyl2YLvW5co24a4b1QrHKxe-gUsr4dMrUCEpxDR6zWD_KLm4Bk3cwlfk4hNmp5i9leGAKkm1QiIqpzezFTJsUXjvMWmhzwdrF-rBiEzLruUMU-sJcxGKSA5CsLgHbTbP1hfXUpSx6neRAPlai3z-pSQWDY24NF6A3-6OSkCG3hoU3AE_K1rvL06uF0eceMSwT6htAHuTdau6JXGwDQQ5ZIfdrp3DwnjtlkJRwVAXJfNmtkjabSpayIFekapkBVAwa4-0Dt2F1CAYJOBK9ReyVQxUNgJaobvCpoJDvwUFzWLEUp2usLF-H0xrFntMyl0Bc8YBFqtrI017kouft3Phzuxty6g%3D%3D)

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

clean_body: But we’re in serious trouble of coming up short at the worse possible moment | Peter, I’m sorry I had to email you so late, so I’ll keep it short. Our campaign to take back Wisconsin and end Schumer’s Majority is facing it's final end-of-month fundraising deadline, and we're $540 short of hitting our FINAL fundraising target at midnight. If just a few more patriots step up before midnight tonight, our campaign will be back on track. For America, Eric Hovde Republican for U.S. Senate | | MEET ERIC Eric's a fourth-generation Wisconsinite, born and raised in the Madison area. He's a serial entrepreneur. He founded and managed his first business in his twenties and then went on to start and build many others. When he is not running his businesses, he is focused on his family and his philanthropic endeavors. He and his brother Steve operate 10 Hovde Homes around the world that provide shelter, supportive services and love to vulnerable children. Join the Conversation: | Paid for by Hovde for Wisconsin

# [Sample Ballots in Minnesota Erroneously Contain Official Ballot Markings](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2066440&post_id=150977508&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTUwOTc3NTA4LCJpYXQiOjE3MzA0MzI1MzUsImV4cCI6MTczMzAyNDUzNSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTIwNjY0NDAiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.EIkq9QmDJKkbF0sQXJ_wWKT_ZeG_q3xH9Mo2n4KMgO8)
### Voting fraudsters are now a simple click, download and print away from creating their own customized official ballot supply in some Minnesota Counties - the proper authorities have been notified!
| | [Benda For Commonsense](https://substack.com/@bendasense)
---
| Nov 1
---
| [](https://substack.com/@bendasense)
---
---
| | | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2066440&post_id=150977508&utm_source=substack&isFreemail=true&submitLike=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTUwOTc3NTA4LCJyZWFjdGlvbiI6IuKdpCIsImlhdCI6MTczMDQzMjUzNSwiZXhwIjoxNzMzMDI0NTM1LCJpc3MiOiJwdWItMjA2NjQ0MCIsInN1YiI6InJlYWN0aW9uIn0.8DjN4h8V5nnN97-_iiug-53oI_0NF1-xJWYQ4Aop2Q8&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email-reaction&r=1hvr60)

| | [](https://substack..KcC87dRvnW4q7HiXCBo-sPH6XnFMnknzfQ3qLt7nrRQ?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/bendasense/p/sample-ballots-in-minnesota-erroneously?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---
What I thought was going to be a quiet catch-up week became much busier following a flood of reports that some of the sample ballots [posted](https://substack.com/redirect/a4736400-05c8-4142-b75c-4d1e276949b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the website of the Minnesota Secretary of State did not contain the familiar "Sample" watermark. As a lawyer who is willing to listen to, and act upon, reports of voter official activism and voter integrity concerns, I get a lot of noise in my professional feed.
This one, however, caught my attention. Why would some counties in Minnesota post a "sample" ballot that did not contain any notation or reference that it is not the official ballot? When questioned as to why the "actual ballot" was posted, one county official responded, "Although there is no uniformity among all Mn Counties, multiple counties have adopted the same practice as [xxxxx] County." I had to read that email multiple times . . . this official admits that there are election administrators in multiple counties that collaborated to adopt a practice to post what appears to be their official ballot on the website of the Minnesota Secretary of State.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a67ea850-e5dd-42fb-adf2-fa18ab750997?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I had to dig deeper. As my readers know, I continue to pursue a [lawsuit](https://open.substack.com/pub/bendasense/p/we-are-going-to-the-minnesota-supreme?r=1rusnm&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web) questioning the use of modems in our election equipment. This journey quickly taught me that the complex technology inside these black boxes is extremely difficult to decipher and is often shrouded with secrecy, and claims of proprietary protection. I have tried to track articles and technology specific reading materials as best as I can. Yet, nothing replaces the old adage that you should surround yourself with people who are smarter than you. As such, I engaged my network to help decipher this _draft v. official ballot_ question, and found out the rest of the story.
Official ballots contain markings on the edges that tell the black box/tabulator that a ballot has been accepted for a specific race and then to count the votes. As my colleagues know, when I request a research project, I want the answer to be readable on a single screen of my i-phone. The i-phone screen explanation I received is here:
"those [marks] tell the machine how to read the ovals on the ballots and what database bucket to put the results into the tabulator for results."
Without those marks, a sample ballot would simply be just an unusable ballot. **To my astonishment, the same Counties that did not include the "sample ballot" designation, actually included official ballot customized marks (timing marks) on the ballots posted on the Secretary of State's website.** Click on the document below to see the unique ballot markings that were on the ballot created and approved by Olmsted County, and published by the Secretary of State on his website:
| Olmsted Sample Ballot With Timing Marks93KB ∙ PDF file
---|---
| [Download](https://substack.com/redirect/d56fc29d-a892-4ecf-b8aa-ef7c87f80c82?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
A snapshot of the manufacturers' election manual provides an explantion of "timing marks" and a "code channel."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/90c0fa06-5566-4dd9-aa37-9ea237717414?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
As is [public knowledge](https://substack.com/redirect/21b91e07-d751-4005-abc4-d756c92a242a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), ballot stock paper can be purchased in bulk by any member of the public. Do you need an envelope to put it in - [click and edit here](https://substack.com/redirect/aba9cf9f-c3a1-40c8-a9d0-d2fcfc9d6e5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It appears that certain county election officials have gone out of their way to provide a mechanism for bad actors to swap ballots during mailing or [transportation](https://substack.com/redirect/ecc81139-8dd8-4c7d-a018-90da6a79452e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), or ballot board processing where [partisan oversight is absent](https://substack.com/redirect/a5a023b6-4c26-4346-8a35-c82eacf28599?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). What about the ability to stuff ballots into drop boxes with forged absentee envelopes and applications?
The saying, "Make it Easy to Vote and Hard to Cheat" seems to have been replaced by, "Make it Easy to Vote, even when you want to Cheat." After all, we don't want to disenfanchise the cheaters.
Fortunately, there are concerned citizens who are willing to stand-up and report these irregularities. There is a process to [report ](https://substack.com/redirect/1c80f3db-bda0-4923-a60e-88ab6f062039?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)suspected voting violations to the County Attorney where the incident occurred. Complaints have now been submitted in Olmsted County, with others under review.
The content of the complaint is as follows:
VIOLATION:
> **Minn. Stat. §204B.43 which makes it unlawful for an election official to knowingly give, or permit a ballot to be printed, in a form other than that prescribed by law;**
> **Minn. R. 8250.1810, Subp. 18, which mandates the format for Example Ballots the election official is required to follow for the 2024 general election.**
> **The format of the 2024 General Election Example Ballot can be found here:[https://www.sos.state.mn.us/election-administration-campaigns/election-administration/example-ballots/](https://substack.com/redirect/d0bdfc97-8a94-4731-8ded-7fc17efcc0d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
> **A copy of the required Example Ballot required by the Secretary of State is attached hereto as Exhibit A.**
STATEMENT OF FACTS:
> **I visited the Minnesota Secretary of State Election & Voting website and followed the instructions for viewing my sample ballot for my home address as listed above. **
> **Attached as Exhibit B is a copy of the ballot that I viewed and downloaded from this website. This "sample ballot" was created by xxxx County Elections and published by the Minnesota Secretary of State's Office on their website.**
> **This ballot is not a proper sample ballot in that it does not comply with the requirements set forth in Minn. R. 8250.1810, Subp. 18 as follows:**
* **The ballot does not contain the required reference "Example" "Example Ballot" or "Sample."**
* **The ballot contains ballot identification markings referred to as "Timing Marks" and "Code Channel." **
* **It is my understanding that these ballot identification markings allow an election tabulator to scan a ballot, read the ovals/votes and tabulate the final votes. **
* **It is further my understanding that the Attached Exhibit B could be treated as an official ballot.**
* **An explanation of these ballot identification markings is attached hereto as Exhibit C.**

> **The publication and distribution of improper Example Ballots such as the attached Exhibit B, by xxxxx County and the Minnesota Secretary of State violates Minn. Stat. §204B.43 as follows:**
* **They are knowingly giving official ballots to unauthorized individuals;**
* **They are permitting unauthorized individuals to download, print and distribute an official ballot. **
* **It is public knowledge that blank ballots can be purchased by any member of the public, allowing them easy access to print official ballots for improper use in the general election.**

clean_body: Voting fraudsters are now a simple click, download and print away from creating their own customized official ballot supply in some Minnesota Counties - the proper authorities have been notified! | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more Voting fraudsters are now a simple click, download and print away from creating their own customized official ballot supply in some Minnesota Counties - the proper authorities have been notified! | | | Nov 1 | | | | | | | | | | | | What I thought was going to be a quiet catch-up week became much busier following a flood of reports that some of the sample ballots on the website of the Minnesota Secretary of State did not contain the familiar "Sample" watermark. As a lawyer who is willing to listen to, and act upon, reports of voter official activism and voter integrity concerns, I get a lot of noise in my professional feed. This one, however, caught my attention. Why would some counties in Minnesota post a "sample" ballot that did not contain any notation or reference that it is not the official ballot? When questioned as to why the "actual ballot" was posted, one county official responded, "Although there is no uniformity among all Mn Counties, multiple counties have adopted the same practice as [xxxxx] County." I had to read that email multiple times . . . this official admits that there are election administrators in multiple counties that collaborated to adopt a practice to post what appears to be their official ballot on the website of the Minnesota Secretary of State. | | ---|---|--- I had to dig deeper. As my readers know, I continue to pursue a questioning the use of modems in our election equipment. This journey quickly taught me that the complex technology inside these black boxes is extremely difficult to decipher and is often shrouded with secrecy, and claims of proprietary protection. I have tried to track articles and technology specific reading materials as best as I can. Yet, nothing replaces the old adage that you should surround yourself with people who are smarter than you. As such, I engaged my network to help decipher this draft v. official ballot question, and found out the rest of the story. Official ballots contain markings on the edges that tell the black box/tabulator that a ballot has been accepted for a specific race and then to count the votes. As my colleagues know, when I request a research project, I want the answer to be readable on a single screen of my i-phone. The i-phone screen explanation I received is here: "those [marks] tell the machine how to read the ovals on the ballots and what database bucket to put the results into the tabulator for results." Without those marks, a sample ballot would simply be just an unusable ballot. To my astonishment, the same Counties that did not include the "sample ballot" designation, actually included official ballot customized marks (timing marks) on the ballots posted on the Secretary of State's website. Click on the document below to see the unique ballot markings that were on the ballot created and approved by Olmsted County, and published by the Secretary of State on his website: | Olmsted Sample Ballot With Timing Marks93KB ∙ PDF file ---|--- | A snapshot of the manufacturers' election manual provides an explantion of "timing marks" and a "code channel." | | ---|---|--- As is , ballot stock paper can be purchased in bulk by any member of the public. Do you need an envelope to put it in - . It appears that certain county election officials have gone out of their way to provide a mechanism for bad actors to swap ballots during mailing or , or ballot board processing where . What about the ability to stuff ballots into drop boxes with forged absentee envelopes and applications? The saying, "Make it Easy to Vote and Hard to Cheat" seems to have been replaced by, "Make it Easy to Vote, even when you want to Cheat." After all, we don't want to disenfanchise the cheaters. Fortunately, there are concerned citizens who are willing to stand-up and report these irregularities. There is a process to voting violations to the County Attorney where the incident occurred. Complaints have now been submitted in Olmsted County, with others under review. The content of the complaint is as follows: VIOLATION: Minn. Stat. §204B.43 which makes it unlawful for an election official to knowingly give, or permit a ballot to be printed, in a form other than that prescribed by law; Minn. R. 8250.1810, Subp. 18, which mandates the format for Example Ballots the election official is required to follow for the 2024 general election. The format of the 2024 General Election Example Ballot can be found here: A copy of the required Example Ballot required by the Secretary of State is attached hereto as Exhibit A. STATEMENT OF FACTS: I visited the Minnesota Secretary of State Election & Voting website and followed the instructions for viewing my sample ballot for my home address as listed above. Attached as Exhibit B is a copy of the ballot that I viewed and downloaded from this website. This "sample ballot" was created by xxxx County Elections and published by the Minnesota Secretary of State's Office on their website. This ballot is not a proper sample ballot in that it does not comply with the requirements set forth in Minn. R. 8250.1810, Subp. 18 as follows: The ballot does not contain the required reference "Example" "Example Ballot" or "Sample." The ballot contains ballot identification markings referred to as "Timing Marks" and "Code Channel." It is my understanding that these ballot identification markings allow an election tabulator to scan a ballot, read the ovals/votes and tabulate the final votes. It is further my understanding that the Attached Exhibit B could be treated as an official ballot. An explanation of these ballot identification markings is attached hereto as Exhibit C. The publication and distribution of improper Example Ballots such as the attached Exhibit B, by xxxxx County and the Minnesota Secretary of State violates Minn. Stat. §204B.43 as follows: They are knowingly giving official ballots to unauthorized individuals; They are permitting unauthorized individuals to download, print and distribute an official ballot. It is public knowledge that blank ballots can be purchased by any member of the public, allowing them easy access to print official ballots for improper use in the general election. name: Chairman Richard Hudson
subject: Taking a break to say THANK YOU
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the NRCC and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
I'm working to defend our House Majority, but I needed to take a minute just for you

|
---
| | | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z665drd3uakid9355f5op0sot2otkj4bvqua0ap8_rp22sh2s8i6epj0c5im8or2c9h2bs)
---

Dear Friend,

As we enter the final days before Election Day, I want to take a moment to reflect on the incredible journey we've shared. From the earliest days of this election cycle, you've been the driving force behind our efforts to grow the House Majority.

As Chairman of the National Republican Congressional Committee, I've had the privilege of traveling the country, working with our candidates, and seeing your impact firsthand. Your generosity has allowed us to build a top-notch team, craft cutting-edge campaigns, and fight the Democrat machine.

But I know that our success isn't just about House Republicans - **it's about the countless hours you've volunteered, your thoughtful survey responses, and the contributions you've given to fuel our movement. You're the unsung hero of our party, and I'm honored to stand alongside you in this fight.**

Now, as we sprint to the finish line, I need your help one more time if you can spare a few dollars.

**[We're facing a fierce battle in the final days of this election, and every dollar counts. That's why I'm humbly asking you to make a final contribution to help defend our razor-thin House Majority.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zr8p0tfgpek34b13te90u7jgdo63tubs44c0n0i8_rp22sh2s8i6epj0c5im8or2c9h2bs "We're facing a fierce battle in the final days of this election, and every dollar counts. That's why I'm humbly asking you to make a final contribution to help defend our razor-thin House Majority.")**

Your donation will go directly towards our Get Out the Vote efforts, advertising, and other key pieces of our campaign operation. It will help us defend our vulnerable incumbents, _flip key seats, and elect a new generation of conservative leaders._

If you can swing it, one last contribution would mean the world to me, but if not, please don't stress, you've done so much for us already.

Thank you and God Bless America,

**Richard Hudson **
_Chairman_ , National Republican Congressional Committee

My Republican opponent is threatening to pull funding from North Country Public Radio (NCPR). (Careful about [clicking to the article](https://substack.com/redirect/cbe2801e-fd87-48f6-8d68-d1de5dc52ef4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), as it will boost the stats for the NY Post.)
Fancy that. Stefanik was not able to introduce a bill to avert the issues at the Northern border that she screams about incessantly, but she thinks she is powerful enough that she can "pull funding" from NCPR for their reporting on her early voting activity.
NCPR -- one of those North Country resources that quite a few of us enjoy on a daily basis. She wouldn't know about daily life in NY-21. She is never here.
I'm guessing she is voting early because she won't be in the district on November 5. But who knows? She lets the press know of her in-district appearances after the fact.
North Country This Week, after posting quite generous candidate profiles, also published a Letter to the Editor from Stefanik.
I sent them the letter below. I have no idea if they will publish it or not.
Happy All Saint's Day.
_________________________
Here is the letter I have submitted to North Country This Week: Representatives in Congress take an oath of office, swearing or affirming that they "will support and defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies, foreign and domestic..."
Representatives swear to "bear true faith and allegiance to the same."
Holding on to a "big lie" regarding the results of a prior election is incompatible with an oath of "allegiance" to the U.S. Constitution.
Supporting those who stormed the Capitol on January 6, 2021 is also incompatible with an oath of "allegiance". And a candidate who seeks to pardon those who beat our officers in blue at the Capitol that day has no business claiming to "back the blue."
January 6, 2021 was the same day that a crowd set up a noose and viciously chanted for the sitting Vice President to be hung. A U.S. Representative cannot serve with "true faith and allegiance" without being willing to rebuke that behavior.
A person can not truthfully swear to the oath to serve as U.S. Representative while actively supporting someone who has been found guilty of 34 felonies for lying and covering up certain payments in an attempt to throw the results of the election that was held 4 short years ago.
At the very least, you wouldn't want your Representative to cheer for the guy who calls veterans "suckers and losers", or who seeks to grab women inappropriately. At least - I wouldn't want my daughter, my sister, or my friend grabbed that way or even talked about that way. Would you?
New York's 21st Congressional District needs a Representative who upholds the U.S. Constitution.
NY-21 also needs a climate change policy.
NY-21 needs a border policy.
Healthcare.
Housing.
A bill to prevent price gouging.
Tax breaks - not for corporations, but for ordinary income earners.
Protection of Social Security, Medicare, and Veterans benefits.
The people of NY-21 need a Congressional Representative who shows up and allows for unscripted dialogue, question-and-answer, and free exchange of opinion.
It is time for a change in New York's 21st Congressional District.
I am asking for your vote so that New York 21 can have a representative who can take the oath of office without reservation or conflict of interest, who can work to bring on issues that matter to the people, and who is available at public events with proper notice advertised in advance of an appearance.
Remember: our current Representative could have introduced a bill in Congress to address the crisis at our Northern border. And as Republican Conference Leader, she could have gathered the support from colleagues to get the bill passed. She did not. She kept the border crisis alive during the campaign season.
My current opponent has based her campaign activities out of state in Charlottesville, Virginia. She has a few local offices, including one in Potsdam. But the "hub" of her campaign headquarters, which could have created North Country jobs and internships for young people interested in politics, is not even located in New York State!
New York's North Country voters need better representation.
I am asking for your vote in 2024. Early Voting continues on November 1, 2, and 3 from 9:00am to 5:00pm. Election Day Voting is on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, from 6:00am to 9:00pm.
Sincerely,
Paula Collins
Candidate for Congress, NY-21
_If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democratic and Working Families Party Candidate for New York's 21st Congressional District. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. _

body:

BREAKING: A federal judge is now considering...

---
Dear Friend,
---
On October 22, a federal judge decreed that I had 7 days to hand over my home in New York – as well as my only car and sentimental keepsakes and heartfelt gifts that I collected over the span of 80 years.
---
_I thought that would be the end of the damage..._
---
But with the election right around the corner, Kamala’s Deep State _truly_ wants to ruin me with all they’ve got. They’re now considering dealing one final blow to me.
---
**A judge may now order me to give up my _remaining_ home in Florida – __my primary residence.__**
---
As my lawyer inquired: _**do they truly want me homeless?**_
---
Over the last few days, we’ve heard ridiculous claims about President Trump being a “fascist.”
---
Let me tell you what fascism is... Fascism is weaponizing the legal system to punish your political opponents. Fascism is having your home taken from you. Fascism is taking the law license away from your opponent’s lawyer. Fascism is trying to turn your enemies into political prisoners.
---
[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zv443nnurkebm9c13197qd9ac8v5t54tdqlckbl0_rp22sh2s8i6epj0c5imaoj6c5h2bs)
__
---
_**I am _living through_ the Democrats’ fascism right now.** _
---
I sincerely pray that freedom, justice, and the truth prevail on Tuesday, November 5 – or the damage done to me will spread like wildfire to the rest of our great Republic.
---
**But, as I wrote to you in an earlier letter, the Bible reminds us that our earthly possessions will always fade, but greater “heavenly treasures” await us.**
---
_The pursuit of truth, freedom, and justice are worth infinitely more than a car or a home. Possessions come and go, but I could _NEVER SURRENDER_ my fight for freedom and for what I know to be _true.__
---
I would be tone deaf if I didn’t acknowledge that times are tough right now for _all_ Americans, not just me, so please stop reading here if you cannot give at this time.
---
_But funding my Legal Defense Trust is my last remaining hope of fighting for my freedom and for the liberty and justice of all Americans._
---
[**So, if you can, and, seriously, only if you can, please make a contribution to my Legal Defense Trust – the Rudy Giuliani Freedom Fund – as I keep fighting for my freedom and justice as Kamala’s Deep State tries to JAIL me for life.**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zgmoqo36v3rfalv0e324mojt1t22nv6h046rc2fg_rp22sh2s8i6epj0c5imaoj6c5h2bs)

| | Dear Friend,

I'm thrilled to introduce an extraordinary opportunity for you...

Perhaps you've wondered where the artwork accompanying the lectures in our free online courses comes from. We hear this especially for one of our most popular courses, "The Genesis Story."

The Book of Genesis has inspired some of Western Civilization's greatest artists to produce iconic works. You may be familiar with Michelangelo's "The Creation of Adam" and Rembrandt's "The Sacrifice of Issac."

I can still remember seeing "The Creation of Adam" right after I graduated from Hillsdale at the Sistine Chapel...

[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zcaph1ml4n4vd7mo66l045i1rdd6620pqjv592t8_rp22sh2s8i6epj0c5imeo34chh2bs) **We 've compiled these paintings, along with many others featured in this course, into a brand-new coffee table book, "The Genesis Story: Course Companion." And I'd like you to receive a copy.**

With this exclusive book--available only from Hillsdale College--you can read the passages from the Book of Genesis that led Michelangelo, Rembrandt, Gustave Dore, and other masters to create these incredible works of art.

And with these works all in one place, you and your family can enjoy page after page of divinely inspired art.

**You can reserve your copy of "The Genesis Story: Course Companion," an exclusive hard-cover book from Hillsdale College, for a generous donation of $100 or more by clicking the secure link below: **

Thanks again for your continued support and generosity. I hope you'll enjoy this beautiful book.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01

Hillsdale College

name: Chairman Richard Hudson
subject: Taking a break to say THANK YOU
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the NRCC and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
I'm working to defend our House Majority, but I needed to take a minute just for you

|
---
| | | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zqmdsekp741ofv247h4dd76634f2049anrat4po8_rp22sh2s8i6epj0c5imeo34c5h2bs)
---

Dear Friend,

As we enter the final days before Election Day, I want to take a moment to reflect on the incredible journey we've shared. From the earliest days of this election cycle, you've been the driving force behind our efforts to grow the House Majority.

As Chairman of the National Republican Congressional Committee, I've had the privilege of traveling the country, working with our candidates, and seeing your impact firsthand. Your generosity has allowed us to build a top-notch team, craft cutting-edge campaigns, and fight the Democrat machine.

But I know that our success isn't just about House Republicans - **it's about the countless hours you've volunteered, your thoughtful survey responses, and the contributions you've given to fuel our movement. You're the unsung hero of our party, and I'm honored to stand alongside you in this fight.**

Now, as we sprint to the finish line, I need your help one more time if you can spare a few dollars.

**[We're facing a fierce battle in the final days of this election, and every dollar counts. That's why I'm humbly asking you to make a final contribution to help defend our razor-thin House Majority.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z0ucvjq0ftqfjkvngnpvm18q0hpel594ngfn8hv8_rp22sh2s8i6epj0c5imeo34c5h2bs "We're facing a fierce battle in the final days of this election, and every dollar counts. That's why I'm humbly asking you to make a final contribution to help defend our razor-thin House Majority.")**

Your donation will go directly towards our Get Out the Vote efforts, advertising, and other key pieces of our campaign operation. It will help us defend our vulnerable incumbents, _flip key seats, and elect a new generation of conservative leaders._

If you can swing it, one last contribution would mean the world to me, but if not, please don't stress, you've done so much for us already.

Thank you and God Bless America,

**Richard Hudson **
_Chairman_ , National Republican Congressional Committee

subject: Taking a break to say THANK YOU
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the NRCC and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
I'm working to defend our House Majority, but I needed to take a minute just for you

|
---
| | | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zkh90a3542lu1bkmr4jkgvdg3vs3749vmep6vvcg_rp22sh2s8i6epj0c5im1o71c1h2bs)
---

Dear Friend,

As we enter the final days before Election Day, I want to take a moment to reflect on the incredible journey we've shared. From the earliest days of this election cycle, you've been the driving force behind our efforts to grow the House Majority.

As Chairman of the National Republican Congressional Committee, I've had the privilege of traveling the country, working with our candidates, and seeing your impact firsthand. Your generosity has allowed us to build a top-notch team, craft cutting-edge campaigns, and fight the Democrat machine.

But I know that our success isn't just about House Republicans - **it's about the countless hours you've volunteered, your thoughtful survey responses, and the contributions you've given to fuel our movement. You're the unsung hero of our party, and I'm honored to stand alongside you in this fight.**

Now, as we sprint to the finish line, I need your help one more time if you can spare a few dollars.

**[We're facing a fierce battle in the final days of this election, and every dollar counts. That's why I'm humbly asking you to make a final contribution to help defend our razor-thin House Majority.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zql5qr43lrp4eg5r96ioac6600lufh4rfq6ll32g_rp22sh2s8i6epj0c5im1o71c1h2bs "We're facing a fierce battle in the final days of this election, and every dollar counts. That's why I'm humbly asking you to make a final contribution to help defend our razor-thin House Majority.")**

Your donation will go directly towards our Get Out the Vote efforts, advertising, and other key pieces of our campaign operation. It will help us defend our vulnerable incumbents, _flip key seats, and elect a new generation of conservative leaders._

If you can swing it, one last contribution would mean the world to me, but if not, please don't stress, you've done so much for us already.

Thank you and God Bless America,

**Richard Hudson **
_Chairman_ , National Republican Congressional Committee

| | Dear Friend,

I'm thrilled to introduce an extraordinary opportunity for you...

Perhaps you've wondered where the artwork accompanying the lectures in our free online courses comes from. We hear this especially for one of our most popular courses, "The Genesis Story."

The Book of Genesis has inspired some of Western Civilization's greatest artists to produce iconic works. You may be familiar with Michelangelo's "The Creation of Adam" and Rembrandt's "The Sacrifice of Issac."

I can still remember seeing "The Creation of Adam" right after I graduated from Hillsdale at the Sistine Chapel...

# Democrats Deliver in the Senate, Help Defend in 2024
---
| [](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2v9wk5-g2k7r9-kyd76rh5/)
---
**Four Battleground States: Ohio, Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Montana.** Defending the Senate is crucial for making real progress on key issues such as abortion, climate change, and Social Security. The leadership of dedicated Democrats like Sherrod Brown in Ohio, Bob Casey in Pennsylvania, Tammy Baldwin in Wisconsin, and Jon Tester in Montana is essential to advancing policies that benefit all Americans. **Abortion Rights** : With ongoing threats to reproductive rights, it is more important than ever to have senators who will fight to protect a woman’s right to choose. Democratic senators have consistently stood up against efforts to roll back these rights and will continue to do so if we maintain control of the Senate. **Climate Change** : Addressing the climate crisis requires bold action and committed leadership. Senators like Tammy Baldwin, who serves on the climate change committee, have been at the forefront of promoting sustainable policies that protect our environment and create green jobs. I'm thrilled to introduce an extraordinary opportunity for you...

Perhaps you've wondered where the artwork accompanying the lectures in our free online courses comes from. We hear this especially for one of our most popular courses, "The Genesis Story."

The Book of Genesis has inspired some of Western Civilization's greatest artists to produce iconic works. You may be familiar with Michelangelo's "The Creation of Adam" and Rembrandt's "The Sacrifice of Issac."

I can still remember seeing "The Creation of Adam" right after I graduated from Hillsdale at the Sistine Chapel...

We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect: after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t. When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families. Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we. So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! Perhaps you've wondered where the artwork accompanying the lectures in our free online courses comes from. We hear this especially for one of our most popular courses, "The Genesis Story."

The Book of Genesis has inspired some of Western Civilization's greatest artists to produce iconic works. You may be familiar with Michelangelo's "The Creation of Adam" and Rembrandt's "The Sacrifice of Issac."

I can still remember seeing "The Creation of Adam" right after I graduated from Hillsdale at the Sistine Chapel...

Dear Friend,
---
On October 22, a federal judge decreed that I had 7 days to hand over my home in New York – as well as my only car and sentimental keepsakes and heartfelt gifts that I collected over the span of 80 years.
---
_I thought that would be the end of the damage..._
---
But with the election right around the corner, Kamala’s Deep State _truly_ wants to ruin me with all they’ve got. They’re now considering dealing one final blow to me.
---
**A judge may now order me to give up my _remaining_ home in Florida – __my primary residence.__**
---
As my lawyer inquired: _**do they truly want me homeless?**_
---
Over the last few days, we’ve heard ridiculous claims about President Trump being a “fascist.”
---
Let me tell you what fascism is... Fascism is weaponizing the legal system to punish your political opponents. Fascism is having your home taken from you. Fascism is taking the law license away from your opponent’s lawyer. Fascism is trying to turn your enemies into political prisoners.

__

_**I am _living through_ the Democrats’ fascism right now.** _

I sincerely pray that freedom, justice, and the truth prevail on Tuesday, November 5 – or the damage done to me will spread like wildfire to the rest of our great Republic.

**But, as I wrote to you in an earlier letter, the Bible reminds us that our earthly possessions will always fade, but greater “heavenly treasures” await us.**

disinformation

more today.

the CIA serves its own interests…not those of the American
people.

it's no surprise that anyone in power who goes after the CIA is
soon not in power.

# [Victorian bakers added a toxic ingredient to make bread whiter.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sm9qpy&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [World History](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sm9qpy&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sm9qpy&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| I n Victorian-era England, as in most of human history, bread was a dietary staple, and white bread, which was seen as containing fewer impurities and was associated with the upper class, was increasingly in vogue. Indeed white bread was so desirable that some British bakers resorted to using questionable ingredients to bleach their loaves. One such ingredient was alum, an aluminum-derived chemical compound that is toxic when consumed. It made bread not only whiter, but also heavier, allowing bakers to charge more for their wares and supplement flour doing food shortages. Alum was also cheaper than flour, meaning bakers could [pocket more profits](https://track.historyfacts.com/?xtl=uogjbh1wjae10bo2c7ytdl35wti1j6sm2qic2m8vk5d509le29en0utxjce4wdswi80klpm6ov43czq8cmsp67i6j9ectkxwklzmi9gsh84vicum11yg4b6dvq5a5w0pv2xiyezox48e23ck3o3lqyw5ukksvn2o8lykbhh4d2hre8nw18txmvih7reli4d26sqexd4wfvcl087my7hzg9m56gqr1z5k43799subizjymrjt992gk68igs4of5bj4vn7v4s4eayku95ri6eglbbomlq2vjq&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sm9qpy&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) — but unfortunately, all this came at the expense of public health.
---
Alum, when consumed regularly, caused digestive issues and diarrhea, the latter of which could be fatal to young children at the time. In the mid-1850s, prominent English physician John Snow proposed a connection between Brits’ poor health — notably the widespread prevalence of rickets, a bone-softening disorder — and the alum-filled bread they were consuming, a theory that came to be viewed in scientifically favorable light in the decades that followed.
Without widespread awareness of these health issues, however, food adulteration — adding cheap ingredients to keep costs down and production up — [persisted](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sm9qpy&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) throughout much of the 19th century; plaster of paris and chalk were also commonly added to bread. Regulations such as Britain’s 1860 Adulteration of Food and Drugs Act sought to curb the use of harmful additives in food, but were not mandatory nor strictly enforced. A revision in 1875 was taken more seriously, and remained in effect for some 60 years until updated government public health guidelines and food safety laws came into place.

## Victorians’ favorite shade of green was poisonous.
[Scheele’s green](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sm9qpy&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), named for the chemist who originally invented it in 1775, was a bright, rich color similar to emerald that was hugely popular in 19th-century England. It also happened to contain arsenic. Despite its toxicity being known by the inventor and some experts, the pigment was used in the production of clothing, wallpaper, and even children’s toys. Contact with arsenic-laced clothing or other household items often resulted in rashes or sores; some people suffered fatal respiratory issues. Factory workers who produced goods with the pigment had it even worse: Matilda Scheurer, a 19-year-old worker who made artificial flowers, died from the exposure, but not before the whites of her eyes turned green. Regulations around tracking and disclosing arsenic use went into effect in the U.K. in 1851, and by the end of the 19th century, manufacturers of various goods had all but replaced the toxin with safer ingredients.

Contact with arsenic-laced clothing or other household items often resulted in rashes or sores; some people suffered fatal respiratory issues. Factory workers who produced goods with the pigment had it even worse: Matilda Scheurer, a 19-year-old worker who made artificial flowers, died from the exposure, but not before the whites of her eyes turned green. Regulations around tracking and disclosing arsenic use went into effect in the U.K. in 1851, and by the end of the 19th century, manufacturers of various goods had all but replaced the toxin with safer ingredients. **Election Day is almost here** , and we’ve got something exciting planned just for you!

clean_body: [ ]TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE I wish I had better news to share with you, Peter. My team just let me know that we came up short of our October fundraising goal last night. This was always going to be an uphill battle. We had to raise our goals multiple times throughout the month to keep up with the tens of millions of dollars Republicans continue to spend on brutal attack ads against me. Now, I won’t tell you that the sky is falling because we missed this goal. But I will tell you the truth, which is that we’re starting November with a significant gap in our budget. That’s a problem because if we need to cut back on our campaign ads or get-out-the-vote efforts this late in the race, Republicans could easily flip this battleground seat. Staying competitive in this toss-up race isn’t as easy for me as tapping into a multimillion-dollar personal fortune like my opponent can. Instead, I rely on folks like you who pitch in what you can, when you can, to help power our campaign. [ ]So I’m humbly asking: Can I count on you to chip in today to help us defend Wisconsin’s Senate seat from my self-funding Republican opponent? ## NYC Busing Immigrants to Texas
New York City has paid for 4,507 asylum seekers to be [transported to Texas](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LuO6yAUheGnwR0RN0NcUJzGXU47pbW52WjwRbCTid9-FPdTL-nT0v_1mB6QS97m_7BGi--0T4IJRTmnjE8Bcjkn1QXrWBh4Fy03kimt7pJ1i-1NCJBcH9Nghr7X0Uk3gFBaQhIyDF22H4xzxrlQTNxvhiXNXXDO343XAxDFYsi41xsuEeMbWirn_or15ve1K3ZBPBqR_4gYiRjBeS4_CxHjsTckYuSS5u0VG-YZMDZ6GXTNc4UNqXu2lreZxpT2io0m8JEez7Y48N90Oz094Gy0RnzWjaaS5-VCe2WY5JqIsas2HD-5lNy0IYrNK-RyncM_a72s-A0AAP__ABFtwA), according to a press release from Mayor Eric Adams’s office. In addition to Texas, the city’s voluntary program has provided tickets to Florida, Illinois, and other parts of New York. Since April 2022, Texas has bussed about [120,000 illegal immigrants](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLuOqzAQhp_GdKCZscGmcHEaupx2S-RbgiWDEfaG5O1XZOtt_6v0fd3mm4kpbo__Zg26vu55JiDRIraAszcxvWfReG3Bj9gEjZKDGITi0Cza-56U7V0_BN4DWNkjV1I5HIee2xGbqK8xREAkAaQ6CfcBrbfWKemG0TABwceaj64uoYaXKff0zs9wdC6vTdJLrXth_B-jidF0nmfnliNvl8to2sJZGE1L_i41b-2nz2gyR40uhSvwdr9qu8bHYbZaWhyVRBp5ty97c2i_nzGlWAbJBDxWE9Pnuf6J4qnpJwAA__98D2Ba) to several Democratic-run cities across the country, including nearly 46,000 to New York City. The Biden administration and Democrat officials have [criticized the initiative](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2O6yAUBp8Gd1iAuYYUFLdxl223tA5_9tFisAyJ47dfJf3Wn_TNaL7v8x0wYV6-YAumvWKZBROSck4Znz1gumbZeWOZv_EuGK4GJkepB9athscbH0bHhqisdtKyqKLQyikH_7QL0KF5n3HOOBeSCd0rFkduvbVOKzfegEgWPLZy9G0NLbygxnSVZzh6V7YumbW1vZLhPxETEdN5nn0srxzO-t6JmPaSsKGrREwVsmsPOC7qsF20huwxL7St5VEh-0o3XA7IrVIL7od-YHRPkAO1j9odxu8npoR1VESyZQNMH4n2Z5WnEb8BAAD__883aEs) as “political theater,” while Gov. Greg Abbott insists it’s necessary to ensure Texans’ safety and reduce the burden on the state’s resources. In a statement, Abbott called Mayor Adams “hypocritical.”
## East Texans Protest Proposed Reservoir
Around 200 East Texans [attended a meeting](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L2OgzAQBOCngc7If_wVLq6hy7VXogWvYysGI3svJG9_Iv2Vo5E-jebnNt8gxLDfv2FDQy-XZsmlZkIwLmYLIb5nXVuzcDuKGo3oFdedHhSvvekQcRRaDtCCalsLsufKOecWOapW8TqYCxOCCyE1l0PTc9eJxS7LOvRrN0KlOdpAKTfkkfAFxcV3emJu1rTV0Xiio1Tqq5JTJafzPJsH0uMqKznteJZKTpQOVijlgFdCKMQuaS_s-C2eLbA-GNwh7IVYxoL5mUJm5IEY-YxAuDPyGDLzafsYdTb2OEOMoXR9pfl9gxA_i-jfi55G_gUAAP__g_9rpA) hosted by the Texas Water Development Board in Pittsburg on Wednesday to speak out against the proposed $7 billion Marvin Nichols Reservoir, which would flood 66,000 acres in the area to provide water for Dallas-Fort Worth. First proposed in 1968, the reservoir has been [opposed by generations of East Texans](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOwyAQRL8Gd2sBJtgpKNK4y7VXWmuzxEgYLCB28venpL9qRhrpafR-79MdffDx8YMbmfpyaZJcKhACuJgs-vCeVGPNzO1VNGRE33Gl1dDxZjWD1UOHksiRFPxq8aLURXZ2RtKknWu8-cCE4EJIxeXQ9txpMdt5XoZ-0VdkipP1NeW2rlTphcWFdzoot0vammDWWvfCuhuTI5PjeZ7tVuJnY3KkCM_C5Bjp_MS3p31PkWItUCkEiCnXFb5cCISWcoGawOa0A8Y37AFjAZcyuIAnWdgwHz5C9MuaQoFMhfKRfGZyxAy3m6i0PanJxu6nD8EX3TPFHxv68H1c_1V4GPkXAAD__1ktd4I), who say it would displace their homes, businesses, and schools. The debate has become more contentious in recent years as the Metroplex has grown rapidly and is expected to double in population by 2080. Although a report drafted by the Water Development Board concluded the project is [timely and both ecologically and financially feasible](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLvOozAUhJ_GdEa-hUvhIg3dv-2W6ICP4WiNHdkOJG-_Svq_mpFGGn36_v7MP0CB4vYHDrT15dOshDJcSi7k7IDCezaNs4two2zQyl4L05lBi2a3q5e3QQvtDAIsg_Tdom_jqG-4eK2ka8h-zqQUUioj1ND2wndyccuyDv3ajcCMQEc15bbuWPEFxYd3OjG3azqaYPdaH4XpO1MTU9N1Xe1R4mdjasLIn4WpKeL1iW_PuFGKEPgFFTN_BIgRc-FQ_nGfMs94UqEUefL8oBIQHMWNH5BPijzSuqdQeMaC-UyUealP92Zqgszvd1l3dHuTrXtcFAKVrmdGbAdQ-OLWX_2dVv0PAAD__4krdiU), officials insist they are still exploring other options to provide additional sources of water for North Texas.
## Man Pays Steep Price For Honking At Deputy
