## Massive Flooding Kills 158 in Spain
Historic flash flooding in Spain [devastated coastal cities](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00L2O6yAQxfGnwR0RDOOvguI2dLntlhYxQ8wu8VjAJvLbr7L91kf66ej_cV2uPuW03__7B9kWeQEFKLWWSi_Bp3wu2AUbiYBMR1aPRuHQq7HvNjvPYUIzIU5RYTQxTL26zYhTmMdp1NQl-9a0VloDotGXGYbhtppVBTX0A5JARSE1LpdPTnvbKOaTn1QuKz-6bLfWjirMPwFOgNvPg2t7TwLcGxbgtBLgjBbgXlxykDu9qgBXD592WcmXdaMqIxd545CoSh8bFRkzc5Ac5Up7-y6n_Eo5Vzn3AlxXbDheKedUh1Gguj98yr-H2l-BnhZ-AgAA__-UJ2XI) this week, killing at least 158 people in one of the country’s deadliest natural disasters. The Valencia area was [the hardest hit](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0zz1rwzAQxvFPI20xd6cXJ4OGLt7StaPRyzlRka1gi7jJpy_u3u2BB37w_7qOV59LXm6ffmbXpjoSkD4hngDH5HN5jVomNzETK8kOewXaGuiNvLszBU9ACowJKSQ6Y0Tv-8BqmkLvvczu0BABkbRW2F3I2hBVhATWWM1CA6fc6tp917y0O0_lVZ-8drHOsrh7a49NqA9Bg6Bh3_cuhHh8goaF903Q4NeWY-FjxvfPupSSLuZd5erSY8-l5M32QsNt9rn8qe2_yqej3wAAAP__gbFUJg) as heavy rains on Tuesday night caused a river to overflow, sweeping away debris and cars, and leaving residents trapped by the surging tides. Buildings, bridges, and businesses have been destroyed, suspending rail services and forcing people to leave their homes for the safety of friends, family, or emergency shelters. [You can see the devastation here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kD1vwyAUAH8N3rB48MBmYOjiLV07Wnw8EloSIpvEyr-v0r3bTXfSfZ3Wky-13M6f_kqu57ZKIZEDcAFr8qW-VhySy0SS1EAOJiXQaDHp4eIwzVELqYO3IOYJAWIKNuZ5tiZLQ0NxbxuAAJCICkYrjQlRRZGE0QaJoaBUetvG71Zu_UK5vtqTtjG261Ddpff7ztQHkwuTy3EcYwhxjG18_DC53OjYmVw22ttji_TmkjrHhD7MhngyWXBMwXIrFHCfDWmLZJTXw-bS_Si1lt1MDMX56kv9i_b_Jjyd_A0AAP__-Dta2g). As of Thursday, [crews continued to search](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00L3uozAQBPCngc7R-pNQuLgmXa69Ei3rddiTwQisRHn7E9f_y9FIo5_mz3N6ohTZXr9x5dhynQwYp7RWoKeEUr6T61PMzIZtz1EPFlzwMPh-iWmGMVDG7IGQ_H1OPgSyY4LZgZ2pl3itaQ1aG-esvo0mhJksQYLgg-POASdp9bj9rbK1hXP51jcfN6prX-LS2n529ldnHp154L7x57yqKxxNqHBnHrnguahcak2nOneUTb2x8EaCioqs2FjRgtuLlQUKnP2YUjaDH-8URk33y4tOO2f6I6b9I6XIGYbOwWtFKf8t7adv3tH8CwAA__954WVd) for people in stranded cars and waterlogged buildings as an unknown number of people remain missing.
## Dodgers Celebration Turns Violent
Authorities made several arrests in Los Angeles on Wednesday night after [violence and looting erupted](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LGOozAQxvGnMd1E9mAgFC6uocu1VyJjD8S3AxPZFihvv8r2W_-kT5_-_x7zwydOx_bX7-TqKjNqtGAMaDNHn_g92ya6lQipbciZodW27_TQNU83jNpoXNEsS4tkwxhGGjscsNX3aMPYJPdZM0Ybg9a25jZi3y-hDTrqvustKasppir59l_SUZ-08ltOyrcge8PuWeurqPaPwknh5JcwfEDh9JJSFU6FTsqewedMpRbYfSTwa6UMZxKmIxCwSE3HBksm_1WApYA_NmIqsAqzXB-MEjfKBS7JHKFQTlTgSofCyXR2RH1HhVOTXXxdiTmVflBWb7tP_HO1_pbudPgdAAD__1e3cVc) as residents celebrated the Dodgers' eighth World Series title in franchise history. The Los Angeles Police Department also issued a warning about a hostile crowd that allegedly surrounded a city bus and set it on fire. [You can see the video here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z7FuwyAQgOGnwVuiu_MBZmDI4qnp0qGjReGcUBETBZo2b1-le9d_-KT__bgcQy55O72Gi_i-1oWAeIe4A1xSyOWx8JD8KkIyDuLRjsBGg9XD2YvmaYoMiNauAg7AJZdGJ8EktNEO2T81REAk5hH3joz5iGOEBEYbFsUgKfd623_WvPWzrOVR73Lbx3oZij_3fm1qPCiaFc0_z6pofqntsJ2kSFveYtgUza2H_tUUzThpnBwyaCCwwNaZ4ebT9TuXkpuxiuF0Cbn8-f2_37un3wAAAP__XSFTaA). Other images showed revelers [throwing objects at police](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDtuwzAQRE8jdTSWK36kgkUad06bUqC4K5sBLQokY8G3D5Q-xRSDAQYP7-s233xMcbt_-ie7tuYZAZWQUoCcycf0nlVPbmVGHnp20g6gjAar-4ebRiKDVmttEccxaPZ2VB6MZb1YOfbRnW9SgpSo1CAvExqzhCEAgdFGcaeAKbZcLt85bu3Ba3rnF5dLyM8-uUdre-2Gjw6vHV79vvFRz-kspcWQuMMrZbpzqeLIJZGoXCJXEUo-qIrl50zZmIQvhWurwitkGXA5OaewmLAOYUJtEQA4LKEvjvYjphSrsZ2C-9PH9MfT_vPzcvgbAAD__xqYZl0) and running from a boarded-up Nike store with armfuls of merchandise. At a news conference Thursday, Mayor Karen Bass said the majority of celebrations were peaceful and discussed today's planned victory parade.
## List: Most Haunted States in the U.S.
New Mexico was named the [most haunted state](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z72OqzAQQOGnsTvQzPgHpXBxG7rcdks04CF4ZXAEDihvv8r22x990vm6D3dOOW2P_7xKqHMZCMg2iA3gEDnl92B1DLMIidESsDNgvYPO6SXg7Ggmj87AyLdp8h05Ew0wR2buRKfw0RABkaw12N7I-3EyE0TwzltRFiSmWvb2u6StLjLndzllb6ey6hyWWp-HMv8U9Yr667ratZwyvmJc-JMo6sdcHor6tRy1Wfi1VYnNUbnKoajXe4jPK-WcDt8pC4-VU_6161-vZ6CfAAAA__9qoVYn) in the U.S. according to a new ranking of states by how scary, spooky and creepy they are. MoveBuddha, an online relocation site, ranked all 50 states using a formula to calculate the number of haunted locations, cemeteries, unsolved murders, and ghost towns, among other factors. But while New Mexico was listed as the most haunted state because of its ancient Indian burial grounds, New York was recognized as the state most likely to give you the creeps. Rather not get spooked? Head for Nevada, Hawaii, or Minnesota, the three least haunted states of all. ## Annual Democratic Gala
_(Coldspring, Texas)_
I’m incredibly grateful for everyone who donated their time and talents to make the first annual San Jacinto County Democratic Gala possible. It was a wonderful experience connecting with members of my own community. A special thank you to State House candidate, Lauren Ashley Simmons, for traveling to Coldspring to be our main speaker.
---

# Voting Locations
_(Conroe, Texas)_
Yesterday, I visited early voting locations in Montgomery County and was inspired by the energy here! Huge THANK YOU to all the amazing volunteers welcoming voters! Your hard work is making a difference! The high voter turnout is so encouraging!
---
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=4ee619571f&e=a2a46ff12c)

## I Voted!
_(Coldspring, Texas)_
Make your voice heard! Early voting is underway, and Election Day is Tuesday, November 5th! Voting is our civic duty and a vital part of participating in democracy. Every vote matters, and together we can shape the future we want to see! Proud to honor my right and responsibility by heading to the poll.
---
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=53ec47c1d4&e=a2a46ff12c)
| | | | | | | | | | |
## Pride Festival
_(The Woodlands, Texas)_
This year was another huge success, with even more vendors and attendees than last year. It's amazing to see this festival grow and bring so much joy to the community in Montgomery County. Thank you to all the organizers and volunteers who made this important celebration possible. Your hard work truly shines!
---
| [](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=e6295a9dbb&e=a2a46ff12c)
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
# Harris Rally
_(Houston, Texas)_
Thrilled to attend the Houston rally for VP Harris and Colin Allred with my friend, Margaret Chandler and 30,000 supporters! The energy and enthusiasm at Shell Energy Stadium were electric! We were inspired by a performance from Willie Nelson and touching speeches from brave women sharing their stories on the impact of losing access to life-saving health care options during unexpected, heartbreaking pregnancy complications. **Let’s stand together to trust women and trust doctors!**
---
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=ac44504c60&e=a2a46ff12c)
| |
## Blue Forest Dem Breakfast
_(Willis, Texas)_
I enjoyed delicious food and engaged in meaningful conversations with passionate activists dedicated to making a difference in their community. As a candidate, I feel fortunate to be surrounded by such amazing people who are tirelessly working towards the upcoming election.
---
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=2ad99396eb&e=a2a46ff12c)
| | | | | | | | | | |
## Public Deliberation Event
_(Houston, Texas)_
I had the honor of spending time with students from the University of Houston Downtown at their public deliberation event!
We tackled challenges at the US-Mexico border, engaging in meaningful discussions alongside candidates, faculty, staff, alumni, and community members. It was inspiring to see everyone share their perspectives and learn from one another.

---
| [](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=899e1fb655&e=a2a46ff12c)

| | | | | | | | | | |
# Candidate Forum
_(Houston, Texas)_
I had the privilege of attending a Candidate Forum hosted by the Muslim community. It was an invaluable opportunity to connect with community members and hear their concerns. Every voice matters, and I'm committed to ensuring that everyone is heard!
---
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=6fd8e3956f&e=a2a46ff12c)
| |
## Monthly Meeting
_(Tomball, Texas)_
Excited to attend the monthly meeting for Cy Tomball Dems this evening! This rapidly growing group is making a real impact by actively organizing their communities. A big thank you to everyone who is carpool canvassing and writing postcards! Let’s keep the momentum going!
---

I was excited to join the Cy-Fair Area Democrats in Houston! Thankful for their unwavering support and dedication to getting out the vote. Together, we can make a difference! Let’s keep pushing for progress!

I feel

basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life.

Our
society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its
most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was
once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has
become the new normal.

Medicine
tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also
tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves,
and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not
treated as though they are alive or even human.

As a
surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you
that they are very much alive.

Life is a
precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No
person is disposable, and every life is precious according to
Him.

I believe
that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this
right by our society. I believe that together we can make a
difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also
believe that I'm not alone in this belief.

I believe
that you believe that too.

I've
started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are
looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that
values life but that takes people like you and I making a
commitment.

The first
step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing
to do to protect the lives of the unborn. Will you join me today
and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?

I've

read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals
and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the

body:
I just wanted to take a moment — just a short moment — to thank you for your support last month and for being a part of this team.
#

Peter, thank you.
I just wanted to take a moment — just a short moment — to thank you for your support last month and for being a part of this team.
Yesterday was the last monthly fundraising deadline of the campaign. Now, we’ve got four more days to do everything we can to win this election. It’s difficult to believe, honestly.
I’ve said it before, but kids who grow up like I did don’t often make it to college, let alone to Congress, or the U.S. Senate. When we launched this campaign I wasn’t sure what to expect. I never would have thought that more than 400,000 people would chip in to help me out. But you did.
From that kid who slept on the floor of our apartment, to the Marine in Al Anbar, Iraq, to today... I can’t tell you how humbled I am to have your support.
But this isn’t over.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-nov24.6f99Bw&refcode=em241101-1-160&t=1&akid=3506%2E734936%2ErcjUlX)
We have four days until the voting ends. Four days to keep up the pace and fight back against the millions being spent against us. Four days to turn the tide and retake the lead in this tied race.
Four days to win, Peter. So I’m setting one more goal. **We have to raise $1.5 million to close up the gaps, cover the costs of these final days of outreach, and dramatically escalate our advertising through Election Day.** With Kari Lake, the “MAGA Queen,” the most prolific election denier in our country up against us, we’ve got work to do.
[**Please. Will you make a $20.24 donation to my campaign? It would mean the world to me if you could chip in for the first time before November 5th.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-nov24.6f99Bw&refcode=em241101-1-160&amount=20.24&t=2&akid=3506%2E734936%2ErcjUlX)

I just wanted to take a moment — just a short moment — to thank you for your support last month and for being a part of this team. Yesterday was the last monthly fundraising deadline of the campaign. Now, we’ve got four more days to do everything we can to win this election. It’s difficult to believe, honestly. I’ve said it before, but kids who grow up like I did don’t often make it to college, let alone to Congress, or the U.S. Senate. When we launched this campaign I wasn’t sure what to expect. | | | Right-wing billionaire and Trump-fanatic Elon Musk reportedly scammed and threatened paid door knockers in Michigan, who didn't even know they signed up to canvas for Trump until they were on the job. Canvassers were transported in a U-haul van without seats or seat belts, and told they'd have to cover their lodging costs if they didn't meet absurdly high target numbers of doors knocked. Between this nightmare and his (probably illegal) stunt involving paying for petition signatures, Elon Musk needs to be investigated for his shady behavior and trying to buy this election for Trump – and, if found guilty, criminally charged. Hi Derek —
It’s finally November, and we are just _days_ away from determining the future of our nation at the ballot box.
Everything we’ve worked toward comes down to these final moments — and I want to take a moment to say _thank you_ for standing with me every step of the way.
This journey has been full of challenges and hard work — from mobilizing voters and supporting Democratic candidates here in California and the rest of the country to the attacks from Trump and his MAGA allies.
Through it all, I’ve been inspired by the way this team has rallied behind me and the issues that matter most to them and their families. Your unwavering support has made all of this possible — and now we’re just days away from the finish line.
We have the opportunity to keep the Senate blue, flip the House, and ensure we can move forward together — every conversation, every volunteer, every dollar raised, and every vote counts in this work.
It’s not just about what we’re fighting against — it’s about what we’re fighting for. So let’s make sure every voter knows what’s at stake and how much better our future can be.
Thank you again for everything you’ve done so far. With your continued support, I know we’ll finish strong and win this race.
All my best,
Adam

name: No Dem Left Behind
subject: The Power of Rural Democrats
body:
Local parties are coming together like never before to build a rural resurgence.
| | | | | |
---
# Rural Democrats Are Being Heard.
---
|
---
The pandemic changed so much for so many Americans. There are a few silver linings amongst those clouds. The world learned how to be more digitally connected and connected across great distances. Rural America is all about great distances. For years, political organizing was an insurmountable challenge in certain districts. Upon No Dem Left Behind's founding, we recognized that obstacle and had a plan to address it. Our early virtual town halls utilized celebrity star-power to spotlight Dems in deep-red districts. Our ROCC forums taught the principles of organizing in a peer-learning environment. Our work on ARPA inspired activism in Republican-led counties. In short, our mission was to connect and empower rural Democrats to build the infrastructure to reshape the Electoral Map in the years to come.
---
|
---
The lesson? After the rain, comes flowers.
---
|
---
It's a pleasure to have you with us in this ongoing journey. And that's how rural Democrats are feeling. Our reward at No Dem Left Behind comes when we step into that local Dems meeting, when we partner and accomplish something together, we get that great, big "thank you". Thanks for recognizing us, remembering us, and making sure we never feel left behind. If you can spare a little to support this work, we'd greatly appreciate it...

name: Reid Rasner, CEO
subject: Peter, can the bulls keep running?
body:
| Hi Peter, The bull market has officially turned two. Markets have also had an impressive run since the bottom of the bear market. Since October 12, 2022, the S&P; 500 has gained over 60%.1 **Can the bulls keep running?** Given the strong performance in 2023 and the strong 2024 we're having, it's reasonable to worry that markets might retreat. You can see in the chart below that consecutive strong years have happened before.2
---
|
---
That said, past performance doesn't guarantee that optimists will continue to drive markets. In fact, it wouldn't be a surprise to see a pullback ahead. **However, there's reason to hope for continued optimism.** The bull run we've experienced this year has a strong grounding in economic factors. **Factor #1: A growing economy generally boosts markets.** While markets are often impacted by short-term trends and investor psychology, stocks generally follow the economy. The latest data shows that economists are upbeat about where economic growth is headed.3 Since the stock market is forward-looking, that's a positive for the bulls. **Factor #2: The Federal Reserve's interest rate policy is loosening.** A big part of the market story this year is the hope that the Fed will be able to lower interest rates without causing inflation to spike or tipping the economy into recession. Lower interest rates are generally positive for markets because they make it cheaper for firms and consumers to borrow money. Lower corporate borrowing costs can fuel growth, R&D;, acquisitions, and other capital-intensive projects that boost stock prices. **Factor #3: Optimism about corporate earnings.** While earnings season is still underway, the general consensus is that corporate earnings are looking solid so far.4 That's great news for markets. A recent survey of corporate leaders also found that the majority expect company profits to increase.5 Taken together, that's a positive for the bulls. **However, there are a number of risks we're watching.** With markets regularly testing new highs, stock valuations are also high. That means some stocks may be overvalued. If investors lose optimism about growth, markets will likely retreat. Uncertainty surrounding American politics and global geopolitics is also high. While elections and conflicts generally don't have long-term effects on markets, they can certainly trigger selloffs.6 **Overall, we're still cautiously optimistic about where markets are going in the final months of the year.** It can be tempting to look at market highs and decide to sell and stand on the sidelines. However, timing markets perfectly is impossible and you risk missing out on future growth. We're carefully watching market trends and economic data as they are released. I'll reach out with any specific recommendations as I have them. Have questions? Hit "reply" and let me know. Warmly,
---

subject: Friend, Hillary ducked the Debate. I showed up anyway!
body:
If Hillary can't defend her record on stage, then she has no business in Congress. West Michigan is ready for a change on November 5.
| | |

Friend

The November 5th Election is only 4[ days away!](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0019iTbOIj9VTOSbSfe3VPwxKn0m3V2Wbw3mqoHkj-gc_ynlFKE9sCjEJ3svKkLZkL8XfOpTcy00LQ214W5GJQFVn3tA6T4DE1ZA9eM8PXstTClhI_-rkVpuvexkuXkyzIwfM_5Cjo7AwJH2smCABPszaclJOKBKmwXm6VCCB-I8GM=&c=fr16YOixIJtELdYNJVeGxWLH2ggO8YhJQ4OPkGHWnq4bY7XI_5fGxQ==&ch=ZEhzMYvf8WxFIARL_I_DcRdF0d7r0L7pFvAlLPOAfQNyjU1OCxyhMA==)
This week, I had the pleasure of participating in the Michigan 3rd Congressional Candidate Forum, hosted by the South Kent Area Chamber of Commerce.
In this important election, each candidate has the responsibility to participate in a public debate and show the voters where they stand. We owe it to people of West Michigan!
Unfortunately my opponent, Hillary Scholten, was a no-show.
---
| [](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0019iTbOIj9VTOSbSfe3VPwxKn0m3V2Wbw3mqoHkj-gc_ynlFKE9sCjEMezbuZpDktV555Rykn3V1aZykiO_dPF-w8Gh9Yh_7MUV8EP147Xh7O6ncnw9nSH81TILYvJapDFG44WVY4l45nm-lUQqcTiMBTSnZPw0mWgGCZ10BNHMkNK2fGkYv23ug==&c=fr16YOixIJtELdYNJVeGxWLH2ggO8YhJQ4OPkGHWnq4bY7XI_5fGxQ==&ch=ZEhzMYvf8WxFIARL_I_DcRdF0d7r0L7pFvAlLPOAfQNyjU1OCxyhMA==)
---
|
We worked with Hillary and her team for months to find a date to debate, but Hillary refused to commit. This is a deep disservice to the voters of West Michigan and to the democratic process itself. In an important election like this, the voters are entitled to hear from each candidate to find out where they stand.
---
| [PAUL ON THE ISSUES ](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0019iTbOIj9VTOSbSfe3VPwxKn0m3V2Wbw3mqoHkj-gc_ynlFKE9sCjEGYk-pgWRgrolLIm9ypvJQSXQMgfkUGWMKaRwAdqTrXPXAJfSDBlJ3zDr4dMWZSe11sqT9tKJysQniqQF1RVMPps6HLaoWP58roN3gzNPHS5gA-V_3VV_A9KdyMNge0Tvw==&c=fr16YOixIJtELdYNJVeGxWLH2ggO8YhJQ4OPkGHWnq4bY7XI_5fGxQ==&ch=ZEhzMYvf8WxFIARL_I_DcRdF0d7r0L7pFvAlLPOAfQNyjU1OCxyhMA==)

Hillary's approach, unfortunately, has been to dodge a public debate in favor of hiding behind millions of dollars worth of tiresome attack ads. The voters deserve better. If Hillary can't defend her record on stage, then she has no business in Congress.
[West Michigan is ready for a change on November 5th and I would be honored to have your vote.](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0019iTbOIj9VTOSbSfe3VPwxKn0m3V2Wbw3mqoHkj-gc_ynlFKE9sCjEJ3svKkLZkL8XfOpTcy00LQ214W5GJQFVn3tA6T4DE1ZA9eM8PXstTClhI_-rkVpuvexkuXkyzIwfM_5Cjo7AwJH2smCABPszaclJOKBKmwXm6VCCB-I8GM=&c=fr16YOixIJtELdYNJVeGxWLH2ggO8YhJQ4OPkGHWnq4bY7XI_5fGxQ==&ch=ZEhzMYvf8WxFIARL_I_DcRdF0d7r0L7pFvAlLPOAfQNyjU1OCxyhMA==)

| **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

We at America First Legal have just filed an **absolutely momentous** lawsuit in Maricopa County, Arizona against their elections officials for repeatedly and egregiously violating the State of Arizona’s election administration laws. The election interference and systematic election law violations we allege in Arizona are appalling, bone-chilling, and have the most serious consequences for every American. subject: The earth is going to explode if you don't give me money
body:
| |
---
Peter, THE WORLD IS GOING TO END AT MIDNIGHT TONIGHT IF YOU DON'T GIVE OUR CAMPAIGN FIVE DOLLARS RIGHT NOW! I bet you're getting a ton of emails along those lines. body:
With less than five days left, I’m checking in on your plans to vote.
Friend, I can count the days left on one hand!
I’ve been driving around the state, checking in on operations county by county. Tuesday’s somewhat of a Super Bowl for secretaries of state like me. I couldn’t be more excited to see Michiganders make their voices heard.
**This will be the smoothest, safest, and most secure election in Michigan history. **
Free and Fair Elections
Improvements Under Sec. Jocelyn Benson **🖥️ Modernized Voter Registration:** Implemented online and automatic voter registration, plus same-day registration on Election Day. **👥 Recruited 30,000 New Election Workers:** A new generation of poll workers is ready to assist you at the polls. **📮 Installed Secure Drop Boxes:** Over 1,000 secure drop boxes are available statewide for convenient and safe ballot returns. **🏠 Enabled Voting from Home:** Every voter has the right to vote by absentee ballot, making it easy to vote from the comfort of your home. **✉️ Mailed Absentee Ballot Applications:** We sent absentee ballot applications to all registered voters to remind them of voting options. **🌐 Launched Online Absentee Applications:** You can easily download and submit absentee ballot applications online. **📣 Engaged Underrepresented Voters:** We've launched programs to increase voter participation in areas with historically low turnout. **🔍 Conducted Comprehensive Election Audits:** We've worked diligently to affirm the integrity and accuracy of our elections.
---
I’m so proud of all we’ve accomplished together since my election in 2018. But this coming Tuesday isn’t about me or the Secretary of State’s office. It’s about you!
Now, I want you to take a moment to think about your vote in this election.
**Already voted?** Think of three friends or family members. Send them a quick text and ask, “Have you voted already? If not, do you have a plan to vote?” You can always refer them to IWillVote.com if they need help.
**Haven’t voted yet?** Take just two minutes to write down your plan. When are you voting? Do you know how you’re getting there? And, do you know where to go?
**[Learn more »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96316859/509618280/-1612268846?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5Nzk4NWIwZS01ZTk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eV4gTuAv9LUgugMLAorKFGVt4mv4suIcinb6IFpZl0Q=&emci=1cc24ad7-aa97-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=97985b0e-5e98-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=9636631)**

---
| This is it—**we’re down to the final 5 days.** Everything we’ve built together, all the energy and hard work, is coming to a head. But to finish strong, we urgently need your support right now.
We’re in the final stretch, and the difference between winning and losing could come down to how many voters we reach in these last few days. The truth is, we’re short on funds to send out crucial voter reminders and digital ads—and time is running out.
Here’s how your donation can make an immediate impact:
* **$25** will help us text **500 voters** who need to be reminded to turn in their ballots.

* **$50** will fund ads that reach **1,000 voters** in these last crucial moments.

If we don’t act now, we risk falling short when it matters most. **Can you chip in $25, $50, or whatever you can right now to help us reach every last voter?**

Hello,
The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous _Dobbs_ decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father.
For decades, Dad was an OB-GYN. He delivered thousands of babies and wrote books on how to get pregnant and to navigate menopause. Dad provided women with full access to all kinds of reproductive health care, including abortions, in the years right after _Roe_ – and he has now had to watch as women’s reproductive rights are gutted in the aftermath of _Dobbs_.
Dad and his clinic faced many threats over the years. It’s no exaggeration to say that he put his own safety – and that of his family – at risk in order to protect the rights of women to make their own medical decisions.
But I’m not sure he ever expected to see a sitting member of Congress attacking him – or my sister who followed in his footsteps – in a national news outlet. **It’s disgusting. These kinds of personal attacks against my family have no place in our politics and do nothing to serve the people of Western and Southern Colorado.**
If extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want to have a conversation about reproductive rights in this country, I am more than happy to have that debate. We can talk about how I support _freedom_ and _liberty_ – and how they support big government intruding into the lives of women. We can talk about how they support a national ban on abortion – with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. And we can talk about how they are so extreme, they even want to ban the pill that’s been used by women for decades.
I am willing to talk all day about the fringe view that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions. **But what I won’t accept is extremists like Lauren Boebert and Fox News attacking my father and my sister.**
I am _incredibly_ proud of my father. He provided health care to women when they needed it during some of the happiest – and most devastating – moments of their lives. Before retirement, he would drive two hours to Planned Parenthood and help teach the next generation of health care providers, like my sister. And no one – not Fox News, and especially not extremists like Lauren Boebert or my new Republican opponent – is going to stop my family from continuing to stand up for a woman’s right to choose.
**We already scared off Lauren Boebert. In 2022, I came just 546 votes shy of winning this House seat. I’m ready to finish the job and replace Boebert in Congress, but these are the kinds of ugly attacks that I’m up against.**

clean_body: The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous Dobbs decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father. Hello, The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous Dobbs decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father. For decades, Dad was an OB-GYN. He delivered thousands of babies and wrote books on how to get pregnant and to navigate menopause. Dad provided women with full access to all kinds of reproductive health care, including abortions, in the years right after Roe – and he has now had to watch as women’s reproductive rights are gutted in the aftermath of Dobbs. Dad and his clinic faced many threats over the years. It’s no exaggeration to say that he put his own safety – and that of his family – at risk in order to protect the rights of women to make their own medical decisions. But I’m not sure he ever expected to see a sitting member of Congress attacking him – or my sister who followed in his footsteps – in a national news outlet. It’s disgusting. These kinds of personal attacks against my family have no place in our politics and do nothing to serve the people of Western and Southern Colorado. If extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want to have a conversation about reproductive rights in this country, I am more than happy to have that debate. We can talk about how I support freedom and liberty – and how they support big government intruding into the lives of women. We can talk about how they support a national ban on abortion – with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. And we can talk about how they are so extreme, they even want to ban the pill that’s been used by women for decades. I am willing to talk all day about the fringe view that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions. But what I won’t accept is extremists like Lauren Boebert and Fox News attacking my father and my sister. I am incredibly proud of my father. He provided health care to women when they needed it during some of the happiest – and most devastating – moments of their lives. Before retirement, he would drive two hours to Planned Parenthood and help teach the next generation of health care providers, like my sister. And no one – not Fox News, and especially not extremists like Lauren Boebert or my new Republican opponent – is going to stop my family from continuing to stand up for a woman’s right to choose. We already scared off Lauren Boebert. In 2022, I came just 546 votes shy of winning this House seat. I’m ready to finish the job and replace Boebert in Congress, but these are the kinds of ugly attacks that I’m up against. = Please use the links in this email to start a monthly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = I knew this campaign was going to get nasty, but I never expected the other side to go after my family. Thank you for being on this journey with me, through thick and thin. With gratitude - Adam P.S. I love you, Dad and little sis. ** Paid for by Adam for Colorado. | Four days. Four days are all that stand between us and victory for the sixth congressional district. After months of hard work, thousands of miles traveled, and hundreds of events we can see the finish line. But we cannot give up yet – we have so much more ground to cover as things really heat up—[**and we need your support to make it happen!**](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=5f69d40477&e=0fced71d8c)
---
| **We need to raise another $10,000 between now and Election Day.** We have the opportunity to bolster our TV advertising during prime NFL and ACC football games. **More than 50% of our congressional district still has not voted.** We need to do everything to make sure voters know they have a better choice. We are running a true grassroots campaign all thanks to your generosity, time, and dedication. We wouldn’t be where we are at without your help.
---
| Together, we are fighting for a better future for our community and nation. To ensure that our message reaches every corner of our congressional district, we’ve launched our billboard campaign, are releasing TV ads, and have been running radio ads left and right.
---
| Our opponent doesn’t have what it takes to represent the people of the sixth congressional district. He is a proud Trump MAGA loyalist. My focus is revitalizing the economy, creating jobs, and ensuring fair wages and protecting workers. I support women’s right to choose, workers and their right to collectively bargain, increased funding for public schools, expanded and optimized broadband, equitable access to technology, and respect for personal privacy and healthcare choices. I am committed to transitioning to renewable energy, tackling climate change, and advocating for a diplomatic resolution to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. My platform offers practical solutions and progressive leadership for a brighter future in Virginia’s vast, beautiful sixth congressional district.
---
| Do you know what my opponent brings to the table?
---
| ❌ Voted against the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act❌ Voted against the Infant Formula Supplemental Appropriations Act❌ Voted against the American Rescue Plan❌ Voted against the Affordable Insulin Now Act❌ Voted against the PAWS Act❌ Voted against the Ending Forced Arbitration of Sexual Assault and Sexual Harassment Act❌ Voted against the Pregnant Workers Fairness Act❌ Voted against the Protecting Older Workers from Discrimination Act❌ Voted against the Lower Drug Costs Now Act❌ Voted against the Equality Act
---
| As you can imagine, the list goes on and doesn’t get any better. My opponent proudly stands with a convicted felon, Marjorie Taylor Greene, Matt Gaetz, and Speaker Mike Johnson. The sixth congressional district deserves so much better.
---
[Donate Now!](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=7baa458cad&e=0fced71d8c)

---
| [**Can you donate $50, $100, or $250 dollars to help us defeat Ben Cline and reach more voters?**](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=9101114af9&e=0fced71d8c)

body:
Jon Favreau here.
If you’re way too online like me, you’ve probably seen a ton of headlines about a bunch of rich guys running for Senate in states where they don't even live.
Connecticut mega-millionaire David McCormick is one of those rich guys, and he’s running against beloved Pennsylvania Senator, Bob Casey.
So look, this will be a _very_ close race, and we need to do everything we can to make sure Bob wins — [**which is why I’m asking if you’ll contribute $5 towards his campaign today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241101-2?refcode=em20241101-2&refcode2=4745_552475_IPLfG2&akid=4745%2E552475%2EIPLfG2)
David McCormick is a former Wall Street hedge-fund exec who wants you to think he grew up on a Pennsylvania farm, which is only true if you think that living in a mansion 10 minutes down the road from a farm where your family raised Arabian horses counts as “growing up on a farm.”
But wait, Peter, there's more: McCormick also thinks the most popular beer in Pennsylvania is called “YANG-ling,” which is like running for Senate in Massachusetts and saying you want coffee from "DOON-kin’ Donuts."
**If it wasn’t obvious before, it’s crystal clear now: David McCormick is wrong for Pennsylvania.** But this will be one of the toughest races of the year for Democrats. McCormick has millions upon millions of dollars of his own to dump into this race, in addition to the backing of Donald Trump and billionaire-funded super PACs.
**Pennsylvania is as competitive as it gets, and with the Senate majority and the White House depending on it, we can’t take anything for granted.**
[**So please, will you chip in whatever you can to Bob’s campaign today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241101-2?refcode=em20241101-2&refcode2=4745_552475_IPLfG2&akid=4745%2E552475%2EIPLfG2)

This is HUGE, friends! Our campaign’s recent ad, featuring the brave survivors of the Ohio State University wrestling abuse scandal, has made national news on NBC!

It’s no surprise that this powerful message is catching major attention – these courageous men, some of whom Jim Jordan personally recruited, have stepped forward to tell the world about how he failed them.
When they went to him for help, saying they were being abused by Dr. Richard Strauss, Jordan turned his back and left them to suffer in silence.
To this day, he refuses to take any responsibility. He’s never even asked how they’re doing!
No shock then that when NBC reached out to him for comment on our ad, he STILL had nothing to say. Once again, his silence is deafening.
Jim Jordan may be silent, but we won’t be. Can you chip in $25, $50, or whatever you can to help us keep this powerful message on the air? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/osu-wrestlers-c2g?refcode=20241101_osu_ad_nbc_link1]

I’ve been working closely with survivors and have been working with a group of bipartisan legislators in Congress to make it easier for victims of sexual abuse to hold their abusers accountable.
My bill would remove some of the legal barriers that prevent victims from seeking justice and ensure they have the support they need to heal.
That’s the type of justice-focused leadership we need in Washington.

Meanwhile, I am committed to standing with survivors, advocating for fair treatment, and ensuring that those who have been wronged get the justice they deserve.
Our campaign is about more than politics – it’s about values, integrity, and doing what’s right.
With less than a week until Election Day, we need to reach every corner of the district with this message. Will you rush a contribution today to ensure we send real principled leadership to Washington and close the door on extremist chaos for good? Tamie Wilson

body:

---
|
---
|
---
Dear Friends,As Election Day approaches, the choice in Virginia’s 5th District has never been clearer. [**My opponent has made his priorities evident by fully embracing Trump**](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6724f782b928d12e06f48ca9&u=https%3A%2F%2Fcardinalnews.org%2F2024%2F11%2F01%2F5th-district-mcguire-pushes-trump-witt-warns-against-maga%2F&w=65b51d9b10fa0e6aff8d6145&c=b_6724f4da611b2238250fde21&l=en-US&s=YQBoKiArUR3vzbvVj4vKBG72U7M%3D) and his extreme MAGA agenda. Meanwhile, I’m here to offer a platform rooted in unity, solutions, and the real concerns of our communities.My opponent's campaign has **centered on loyalty to the former president, anti-LGBTQ+ policies, and questioning the integrity of our elections.**[**He has called the pandemic a “plan-demic”**](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6724f782b928d12e06f48ca9&u=https%3A%2F%2Fdailyprogress.com%2Fnews%2Flocal%2Fgovernment-politics%2Felections%2Fmcguire-accuses-democrats-of-planning-pandemic-at-debate-with-witt%2Farticle_b162a5fe-8ce7-11ef-8e23-73b00a8a51a9.html&w=65b51d9b10fa0e6aff8d6145&c=b_6724f4da611b2238250fde21&l=en-US&s=C3F3bZJ8FXHVESF5ax0ksSzIxa4%3D) and implied that our voting system is flawed. This is not the leadership we need, nor is it reflective of the values that built this district.In contrast, my platform is about strengthening democracy, supporting families, and promoting smart economic growth. I believe in **protecting Social Security, expanding access to healthcare, and creating vocational and educational opportunities** for our young people. These priorities are driven by my deep connection to this district and my belief in the power of community.Let’s make sure everyone understands the stakes in this election. I need your help to spread the word about what’s truly at risk in this race. **Please share this message with your friends and family** , and encourage them to join us in voting for a vision of inclusion and progress for Virginia's 5th district.[**Thank you for standing with me in this movemen** t](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6724f782b928d12e06f48ca9&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fwitt4congress%3Frefcode%3Dab_qr_code%26utm_source%3Dqr_code&w=65b51d9b10fa0e6aff8d6145&c=b_6724f4da611b2238250fde21&l=en-US&s=EKDGGU1FrRvdneUhAQ7OXr3xVzo%3D). Together, let’s create a future we can all be proud of.
---
With determination,Gloria Witt
Democratic Nominee
Virginia’s 5th Congressional District**P.S. Please Join us for a Watch Party on Election Day!**

Peter, As Attorney General Eric Holder put it, North Carolina is **“one of the most egregiously gerrymandered states in the country.”** **Let’s talk about how we got here and how we’re fighting back right now — as we work to win a North Carolina election that’s flying under the national radar.** In October of last year, Republicans in the state legislature manipulated the maps to gain unearned power. And state supreme court justices acted as ideologues instead of neutral arbiters of the law — reversing the court’s own very recent precedent and allowing those maps to move forward. Shockingly, the current gerrymandered maps allow Republicans to hold supermajorities in the legislature _even if_ Democrats win statewide elections. And it’s important to remember that even if Democrats hold the governor’s seat this year, a Republican supermajority in the legislature can override his veto. You’ve probably heard a lot about the governor’s race in North Carolina this election, even if you don’t live there. But here’s the critical North Carolina race not enough people are talking about: A state supreme court candidate has openly said he wants a Republican majority on the court for the upcoming redistricting cycle. He praised North Carolina’s extreme congressional gerrymander. And he joined a deeply controversial ruling that would have established precedent for so-called personhood laws in North Carolina — the foundation for restricting abortion and banning IVF. In October of last year, Republicans in the state legislature manipulated the maps to gain unearned power. And state supreme court justices acted as ideologues instead of neutral arbiters of the law — reversing the court’s own very recent precedent and allowing those maps to move forward. Shockingly, the current gerrymandered maps allow Republicans to hold supermajorities in the legislature even if Democrats win statewide elections. And it’s important to remember that even if Democrats hold the governor’s seat this year, a Republican supermajority in the legislature can override his veto. Democrat Eric Swalwell represents California's 14th Congressional District.
https://ericswalwell.com/ [https://ericswalwell.com/]
Friend —

November???

Wow. It's been one hell of a ride. I genuinely couldn't have done this work without your support. Thank you for your never-ending dedication, passion, and support over these past few weeks.

We're now literally DAYS away from the election. The work we've put in together — you've put in — will decide whether or not we can put an end to the MAGA circus that's taken over Washington.

It's not easy fighting a bunch of far-right extremists day in and day out. The MAGA agenda is dangerous — which is why our work is so important.

I'm glad to say that we've made it through October. Your efforts are bringing us closer to victory. Now, we just need to finish strong.

So, that's all. No ask — this time . Truly, from the bottom of my heart, thank you for believing in this fight. Your efforts are truly the cornerstone of this campaign.

Let's bring this home.
— Eric

## The plan - Sunday, Monday and Election Day...
Sunday night we are LIVE at 7pm on my YouTube (YouTube.com/seanmspicer). We will roll thru the early vote data in the battleground states
Monday - Robert Cahaly from Tafalghar and Seth Keshel will give us the latest in polling and data.
And on Election Day we're planning something big for Election Night and I want you to mark your calendar now. I will be live 8 pm Eastern to midnight (maybe beyond depending on what happens) giving you my unfiltered take, real-time reactions, the data I'm checking AND bringing you into all the different appearances I'm doing on other shows.
Some details are still being worked out, but mark your calendar, subscribe to my YouTube and hit the notification button so you don't miss it.

body:
Tune into the latest installment of the Voices of Reason podcast. | | | |
---
| | | Welcome to the latest edition of _Voices of Reason_ where we’ll recap exclusive news and data featured in our most recent podcast.

This segment dives into 2024 policy priorities should the GOP retake control of the PA House, and big reforms planned for the Auditor General's office in another term.

PA Auditor General **Tim DeFoor** and PA House Minority Leader **Bryan Cutler** shared insights you won't want to miss ahead of Tuesday's election.
---
| **Big Names Make News**
---
| **PA House Minority Leader Rep. Bryan Cutler** discusses breaking down the social stigma surrounding students who choose not to attend a traditional 4-year college after high school. [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=5310ef14fe&e=b7b3eddce2)]

**PA Auditor General Tim DeFoor** offers remote work to his staff, with the condition that they reside within the state to ensure economic benefits reach communities across PA. "If you have students who live in a rural area that come to work for us – they're going to be contributing to that local economy." [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=587fde3991&e=b7b3eddce2)]

**PA Chamber President & CEO Luke Bernstein** shared a story on PA's need for permitting reform. "There was a housing project set up to go in Wilmington, DE and Lancaster, PA. The mayor of Wilmington cut the ribbon as Lancaster continued to work through the permitting process." [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=f203bdd217&e=b7b3eddce2)]
---
|
* * *
---
| **Numbers You Need to Know**
---
| _Public Opinion_
* Twenty percent of registered PA voters say illegal immigration has a "very negative" impact on their community, while **39% report "no impact."** [[F&M Poll](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=bb457433d1&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* 8 out of 10 Americans have an **unfavorable** view of China. [[Pew Research](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=5756adea7f&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Voter Interests_
* 55% of registered PA voters believe the presidential election **outcome could impact abortion** restrictions in the state. [[F&M Poll](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=2dbb306dd6&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Elections_
* Trump’s favorability, though still negative, **is better than in 2016** , a benefit to Republicans. [[F&M Poll](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=733d3ffef3&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* 49% of registered voters support Harris-Casey; 43% back Trump-McCormick, with **straight-ticket voting** up since September. [[F&M Poll](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=d98d8ef4f0&e=b7b3eddce2)]

---
|
* * *
---
| **Community College Grads – The Auditor General's Office Wants YOU**
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=4dd09f1117&e=b7b3eddce2 "Tim DeFoor & Bryan Cutler Talk 2024 Policy Priorities – Keystone Candidate Forum")
---
|
* * *
---
| **Coming Up...**
---
| Two county Election Directors joined us to share **what YOU can expect on Election Day** in Pennsylvania this year.

Tune in **Monday morning** for an exclusive interview you won't want to miss.
---
|
---
|
* * *
---
| _In Case You Missed It..._

Hear from all three candidates for PA Attorney General in this game-changing forum, diving into **A.I., social media's impact on children, healthcare, local DA's impact on retail theft**, and much more.

**Eugene DePasquale** and **Dave Sunday** , plus Forward Party candidate **Eric Settle** shared insights you won't want to miss.
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=7081de3ce6&e=b7b3eddce2 "PA Attorney General Candidates on Economy, Healthcare, Crime, and More – Keystone Candidate Forum")
---
| The _Voices of Reason_ podcast has covered the most important issues in Pennsylvania politics – from [education funding](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=c38a0956eb&e=b7b3eddce2) to [trust in elections](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=c08312d679&e=b7b3eddce2). Secretary of the Commonwealth [Al Schmidt](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=55cd6e5d00&e=b7b3eddce2), PA Treasurer [Stacy Garrity](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=5567a36f96&e=b7b3eddce2), and House Appropriations Chairman [Jordan Harris](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=ec893e74d1&e=b7b3eddce2) are just a few of many influential guests who have joined us for exclusive interviews and roundtable discussions.
Visit the _Voice of Reason_ [YouTube page](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=efb7214d06&e=b7b3eddce2) to experience all the great moments you missed.

body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsHayJnWNZ
Politics often leaves a bitter taste in our mouths...

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osHayJnWNZ

Dear
friend,

Politics
often leaves a bitter taste in our mouths. It's no wonder so many
of us approach it with disdain. The endless mudslinging,
pandering to special interest groups, and policies shaped by poll
numbers rather than deeply held convictions make politics seem
like a world Christians should avoid.

Yet, as
Christians, we can't ignore the rapid unraveling of our culture
or remain passive in the face of the evil we see around us. The
Bible tells us that our citizenship is in heaven (Philippians
3:20) and that we are aliens and strangers in this world (1 Peter
2:11). But does that mean we should leave governing to
unbelievers? Should we invest our time in influencing what seems
transitory at best?

The
answer is simple: Jesus commanded us to be the salt and light of
the world (Matthew 5:13-14). As Christians, we are called to
preserve the spiritual and moral fabric of society wherever God
has placed us. And that includes influencing every aspect of our
culture-entertainment, business, education, and yes, even
government.

As the
upcoming election approaches, how should we allow the Bible to
guide our decisions? In my new 44-page booklet, How a Christian
Should Vote, I offer a biblical framework for assessing
candidates, their faith, policies, and constitutional views. This
practical resource will help you view the election from a
biblical perspective, equipping you to make informed decisions.

There are
4 main questions that a Christian should be asking themselves
before casting a vote:

Is
the candidate a Christian?
Do
the candidate's policies align with the Bible?
What
is the candidate's view of Israel?
Will
the candidate get things done?

You can
receive a free copy of How a Christian Should Vote in time for
the elections by clicking here:
https://ptv.org/nna/how-a-christian-should-vote-by-dr-robert-jeffress-2024/

Together,
we can determine the direction of our country by voting for
leaders who will embrace principles that bring God's favor upon
our nation.

In
Christ,

Dr.
Robert Jeffress

P.S.
Jesus commanded us to be salt and light in this world. Through
the ministry of Pathway to Victory, we are using the most
effective media available-television, radio, print, and
digital-to spread the Gospel! Request your free copy of How a
Christian Should Vote today and join us in making a difference.

| | | | | Hi Friend,

### If you didn't get a chance to watch the documentary, Zurawski v Texas, I HIGHLY recommend you watch it this weekend.

### The Center for Reproductive Rights sums it up:

"In the new documentary feature film Zurawski v Texas, independent filmmakers Maisie Crow and Abbie Perrault show the stark and terrifying reality of what it means to be pregnant in a U.S. state that has banned abortion—and the bravery, grit and determination that it takes to speak out.
Crow and Perrault followed three Texas women who were denied medically necessary abortion care—Amanda Zurawski, Samantha Casiano, and Dr. Austin Dennard—as they brought their stories and battled their case up to the Texas Supreme Court, with the help of the Center for Reproductive Rights’ Senior Staff Attorney Molly Duane."
---
[Watch Zurawski v Texas for free Nov 2 and 3 here](https://theresa4texas.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be937c1781d002a370f5841dc&id=d185adb41d&e=ebba716312)
| | | | | | | | | | |
### If you are able to give, I am sure the Center for Reproductive Rights could use your donation.
---
[Donate the the Center for Reproductive Rights here](https://theresa4texas.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be937c1781d002a370f5841dc&id=77e9f00e46&e=ebba716312)
| | | | | | | | | | | They have cases across the country and could use our support while they fight against the extreme abortion bans that put women's lives in jeopardy.

### If you haven't voted yet, today is the last day of early voting and Tuesday is Election Day.

Thanks for your help.

### Theresa

**Nella Domenici**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

# FROM THE DESK OF LARRY KUDLOW
---
| | Reader,**I am pleased to share with you that The New York Sun, one of my daily must-read papers, is now the exclusive publisher of my regular columns.

I invite you to consider joining the Sun to receive unlimited access to my latest commentary, alongside some of the finest American journalism.

**But there's also far more to what the Sun is building.

As you know, journalism isn't what it used to be.

I've been in the business for decades, and never before have I seen this once noble profession so abused. The major papers are no longer on the side of the American people, and we are right to withhold our trust.

The impact on our democracy is considerable. Without real accountability, the worst actors in government and at corporate institutions have free reign, and patriotic, hard-working Americans are being sidelined and ignored.

The antidote is to join the movement to build a better alternative. That's the American way.

**The charge to restore American journalism is being led by the Sun.** A proudly all-American, principled publication that has plenty of room for conservative thought and conservative writers, the Sun has upheld the highest journalistic standards since 1833. That's 18 years before the New York Times published its first number.**My decision for the New York Sun to become the exclusive publisher of my regular columns was not taken lightly.**

I value their work and have been impressed by their team, but I know they have a hell of a battle ahead. They are the David facing many Goliaths.

They will only succeed if we join with them in this grassroots national effort. Joining the Sun costs as little as a penny a day. I encourage you to sign up today. Every single person counts.

#

Hello, Peter. This is Ken Burns.
As a filmmaker, I've always been deeply interested in the moments that defined the American spirit — the Civil War, the Great Depression, the Second World War, the Vietnam War, the Civil Rights Movement.
These were inflection points where we were forced to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
As Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
Today, we face a new generational challenge. Our system of government is in great peril. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It has never been more important that we come together to ensure that our republic endures for future generations.
To meet that challenge, we need leaders who understand how important our democracy is and what it truly means to serve. That's why I’m writing to you on behalf of Ruben Gallego. Ruben is the son of immigrant parents, the first in his family to go to college, a Marine veteran, and a father.
His opponent, Kari Lake, attacks our elections at every turn. She sows the very same discord that is tearing our country apart. She is dangerous. Where Ruben would unite us, Kari Lake seeks only division.
We need more people like Ruben serving our country, and it would mean the world to me if you could support his campaign.
[**Can you make a donation of $20.24 or whatever you can afford to Ruben’s campaign for U.S. Senate in Arizona? body:
At a rally in Arizona, Donald Trump outdid his previous violent rhetoric as he threatened Liz Cheney.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96334455/509666805/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTEwYmNjMTAtNmU5OC1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=qfeI2p-daUjL3n5FvBTUS0L0AuaoRkqWydRp-GgjWL0=&emci=0fefbe04-6e98-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=510bcc10-6e98-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
On Thursday night, Donald Trump once again threatened a political rival with violence, this time escalating the rhetoric by fantasizing about shooting former January 6th committee co-chair Liz Cheney:
_**“Let’s put her with a rifle standing there with nine barrels shooting at her, OK? Let’s see how she feels about it, you know, when the guns are trained on her face.”**_
[**We’ll talk about why these alarming comments matter in a moment, but if you want to help COURIER’s mission to stand up to violent right-wing rhetoric, can you chip in $25 now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96334462/509666810/-260044646?refcode=20241101-EM-TrumpCheney&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTEwYmNjMTAtNmU5OC1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=qfeI2p-daUjL3n5FvBTUS0L0AuaoRkqWydRp-GgjWL0=)
Trump’s calls for violence aren’t new, but as Election Day draws near, his threats are getting more desperate and graphic.
Liz Cheney has campaigned alongside Vice President Harris in recent weeks, arguing that, despite being a Republican herself, she can’t support Trump because of the dangerous threat he poses to our democracy.
**On Thursday, Cheney responded to Trump’s violent fantasy by saying, this is how “dictators destroy free nations.”**
She’s right. Just days from Election Day, Trump is already priming his supporters to believe the 2024 election will be fraudulent. And, he’s trying to create a climate of fear and violence against his political opponents.
**These are the exact same circumstances that led to the attacks on the Capitol on January 6.**
Here at COURIER, we are not afraid to stand up for truth and democracy. We will publish our fearless, factual coverage of Trump and his authoritarianism so every voter understands the magnitude of the threat to our nation.
And, we’ll continue that coverage well after Election Day. That means we can do our part to call out another big lie as it takes shape in real time.
[**But, to do that, we need your help. We rely on supporters like you to fund our newsrooms. clean_body: At a rally in Arizona, Donald Trump outdid his previous violent rhetoric as he threatened Liz Cheney. Peter, On Thursday night, Donald Trump once again threatened a political rival with violence, this time escalating the rhetoric by fantasizing about shooting former January 6th committee co-chair Liz Cheney: “Let’s put her with a rifle standing there with nine barrels shooting at her, OK? Let’s see how she feels about it, you know, when the guns are trained on her face.” = Trump’s calls for violence aren’t new, but as Election Day draws near, his threats are getting more desperate and graphic. Liz Cheney has campaigned alongside Vice President Harris in recent weeks, arguing that, despite being a Republican herself, she can’t support Trump because of the dangerous threat he poses to our democracy. On Thursday, Cheney responded to Trump’s violent fantasy by saying, this is how “dictators destroy free nations.” She’s right. Just days from Election Day, Trump is already priming his supporters to believe the 2024 election will be fraudulent. And, he’s trying to create a climate of fear and violence against his political opponents. These are the exact same circumstances that led to the attacks on the Capitol on January 6. Here at COURIER, we are not afraid to stand up for truth and democracy. We will publish our fearless, factual coverage of Trump and his authoritarianism so every voter understands the magnitude of the threat to our nation. And, we’ll continue that coverage well after Election Day. subject: A Letter from Minnesota, With Love

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/schultz-october-2024?refcode=20241031 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/schultz-october-2024?refcode=20241031]
Dear Americans,
I’m a Minnesotan, home of Lake Wobegon, where all the women are strong, all the men are good-looking, and all the children are above average. Minnesotans have grit, a strong work ethic, love to join community clubs, gladly shovel their neighbor’s sidewalk, and have never been able to accept a complement. We’re okay being a flyover state or being confused with Wisconsin—we’re humble and it’s not our place to correct folks or tell them what to do or what to think. We’re fiercely independent, believe we can pull ourselves up, but realize not everyone can and we’re happy to give others a boost.
I’m writing to you because I love our country, our America. I’m losing sleep because I’m worried about our future. And sleep is very important to a Midwesterner. I’ve been campaigning for Congress for two years in a district that was solidly blue with strong labor unions for 70 of the last 77 years, but in the last presidential election supported Trump by 15 points. I was a state legislator for 8 years, and have seen our communities become divided, so unusual because they have survived by being together.
Our country is strong because of our diversity. It is something that should be cherished. Our country is wealthier and more powerful than the rest of the world. We opened our doors—immigrants came to America to build their dream, find their freedom. Immigrants became Americans, proudly serving our country, waiving the American flag. Our melting pot created a country that is the envy of the world. Our experiment has held.
Minnesota is the state that has provided two vice presidents, Hubert Humphrey and Walter Mondale, scrappy Senators like Paul Wellstone, and smart, respected Representatives like Jim Oberstar. Leaders are not born they are molded by their experiences. And Minnesota shaped these leaders. Our leaders cared about their neighbors, wanted to ensure that the most vulnerable had the opportunities and resources to live a good life. Humphrey laid the foundation for civil rights and fought for fair employment, organized labor, and humanitarian foreign aid. Mondale changed the role of the Vice Presidency, making it a true part of the executive branch. He knew his role was to help and to support the President, he said “I wanted to be a trouble shooter, and I wanted to take on chores around the country and around the world.” He called for a more accountable Presidency under the checks of the Cabinet, the Congress, the media, and the public. He carried on the Minnesota tradition of championing civil rights, the Equal Rights Amendment, and progressive values. After he lost the presidential race in 1984, he told his children that even if he hadn't won the people's votes, he felt he had won their respect by telling the truth, and he was proud of that. You see, Minnesotans are truth tellers, to such a degree that it may hurt their own cause. Mondale told voters that if they wanted to reduce the national debt, we would either need to cut spending or increase taxes—neither a popular option. When Mondale lost his bid to be President he said, “I'd rather be the underdog in a campaign about decency than to be ahead in a campaign only about self-interest.” Reminding us about the importance of respecting others, having empathy, and wanting our neighbors to succeed. After the election, Mondale told his children, "There are many things worse than losing a campaign, including losing your integrity or your self-respect." After spending the last two years listening to people, I realize we need Minnesota values now more than ever.
Minnesota has shaped Tim Walz as well. He truly is humble. He knows the importance of being a team, helping your neighbors, and earning your respect. Walz has learned and grown as a Minnesota politician—he’ll be the Midwestern humble voice giving support and encouragement. He’ll be a cheerleader for America and a coach creating a team that is united to help face what’s to come. He will make us proud to be Americans and will spread the joy that so many of us need. Minnesota has offered up another leader and the rest of the country should seize the opportunity to take him from us.
Paul Wellstone said, “I don't think politics has anything to do with left, right, or center. It has to do with trying to do right by people.”
I’m relying on you, Americans, to do right by people; to participate in our democracy, to vote with compassion—you have the power to protect our experiment, to keep our dream alive—it’s in your hands.
Respectfully,
Jen Schultz

Well, when I went to vote yesterday, I had the displeasure of running into Rick Scott myself, as he rallied Miami Republicans in a misguided attempt to try and intimidate me for social media clicks. As soon as he saw me there, he sped off in his chauffeured getaway car. Disappointing? Yes. Surprising? Hardly. It's just who he, Donald Trump, and the GOP are: Bigots, cowards, and losers. First, Rick took a note out of Trump's playbook when he refused to debate me. Then, he comes to my home district and doesn't even have the courage to face me, not to mention answer for his puppet-master's despicable attitudes. Now, he's panicking, and desperately trying to placate Florida's large Puerto Rican population, whose votes he's courting to win and stay in power. The best way he could earn our forgiveness now is by leaving my people in peace, starting by staying out of politics entirely. Sadly, cowards like him don't have the decency to do the right thing and leave us be. But with the massive fortune he used to buy the 2018 election, he won't leave without a groundswell of Florida voters saying ya no mas, too. And with just 4 days left in this race, I won't galvanize the movement to unseat him if I can't make my crucial $10 million goal by midnight on Thursday. In short, I can't bring him to account at the ballot box on Election Day without your grassroots support, tonight. name: OKGOP
subject: It’s November, and voting is already happening!
body:
| [ ](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=urG6o0YzHACIJY0G92IOaIOiUFGhm1XQHaiZ59fvCoY&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_it_s_november_and_voting_is&n=1)
---
Peter, early voting is continuing in Oklahoma today & tomorrow. And we need all Republicans to get out & vote. The times early voting is available today (Friday) is 8:00 am to 6:00 pm & tomorrow you can early vote during the hours of 8:00 am to 2:00 pm. If you aren’t sure where early voting happens in your county, [you can find out here](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=wM4juC3s27v2X_v1YR_CkJQV7jg8laevmHXL9LvpItYPgPRPFIArNzpc8T9ZT3Pb&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_it_s_november_and_voting_is&n=2). One of the most impactful votes you will cast is on the **THREE State Supreme Court judges** on the ballot for retention. The voters in Oklahoma are being asked “should these judges be retained on the Oklahoma Supreme Court?” And the answer is **NO, they should not be retained!** You’ve heard plenty about the Presidential Election, and voting straight party Republican will restore our economy, but **we MUST get rid of these liberal judges**. [](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=urG6o0YzHACIJY0G92IOaOEva1Jz4u7JgJ_UBwFRQd8&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_it_s_november_and_voting_is&n=3)
All three judges are very liberal ([check out the score card made by OCPA scoring their liberal records](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=R0gp0cTD5kYBAQC5bVnB3XVO9E9Tcb5I5YUIqFW6P11j1IaEUYnjuB5z73zAHt1w&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_it_s_november_and_voting_is&n=4)) by [clicking here](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=R0gp0cTD5kYBAQC5bVnB3XVO9E9Tcb5I5YUIqFW6P11j1IaEUYnjuB5z73zAHt1w&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_it_s_november_and_voting_is&n=5), and they were all appointed by Democrat Governors. They’ve constantly legislated from the bench with their decisions in order to force their liberal agenda on the people of Oklahoma. For more information on these judges & the other judges on the ballot please visit [OKGOP.com/judges/](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=urG6o0YzHACIJY0G92IOaOEva1Jz4u7JgJ_UBwFRQd8&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_it_s_november_and_voting_is&n=6). There you can download a pdf to print at home, email to your family & friends, or distribute however you choose. ## Cold War 2.0
---
Peter Ohtaki
---
We’re in a new version of the Cold War, call it Version 2.0. Our adversaries today are the same countries we faced 50 years ago: **Russia** (fka Soviet Union), **China** , [**Iran**](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6725092bb928d12e06f81192&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mainstreamrevolution.com%2Fblog%2F2019%2F4-27%2Fethnicstudiesgaza%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D672309a64acd596429584c7f%26ss_email_id%3D6725092bb928d12e06f81192%26ss_campaign_name%3DCold%2BWar%2B2.0%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2024-11-01T17%253A00%253A47Z&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_672309a64acd596429584c7f&l=en-US&s=BHUUkDU6cZ4jRBCSOWScsX31aQk%3D), and **North Korea**. What makes this Version 2.0 is China is now our largest trade partner and economic competitor, compared to what it was in the 70s. The Chinese Communist Party (CCP) continues to suppress individual rights, as demonstrated in the Tiananmen Square massacre of liberty-seeking students in 1989. The [CCP’s Made in China 2025 plan’s goa](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6725092bb928d12e06f81192&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.isdp.eu%2Fpublication%2Fmade-china-2025%2F%23%3A%7E%3Atext%3DMIC%25202025%2520is%2520an%2520initiative%2Ccompete%2520both%2520domestically%2520and%2520globally.&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_672309a64acd596429584c7f&l=en-US&s=6HQfCaniekWs-z1EANXiDcrSLVA%3D)l is to lead in 10 technologies, and Chinese companies are notorious for stealing American intellectual property.
#### **Democratic Presidents try to nuance diplomacy and wind up sending mixed messages to our adversaries. Republican Presidents come across as belligerent or unpredictable.**
President Biden started his term with a chaotic withdrawal from Afghanistan, which sent a message of weakness to our adversaries. He’s done an admirable job standing up to Putin by supporting Ukraine, but his administration telegraphs our intentions by listing in detail the arms we provide the Ukrainians to avoid antagonizing Russia. Russia can simply stay its course well past the willingness of the West to support Ukraine.. Reagan used the CIA to supply weapons to our allies covertly. In April, the Biden administration restricted shipping 1,500 lb bombs to Israel to prevent them from using air strikes against Rafah, in Gaza. However, the Iranians fired drones, rockets and cruise missiles at Israel in April and October, so what kind of message does that send to the Ayatollahs?
#### **What we learned in Vietnam is the President shouldn’t micromanage wars**
Earlier in October as war escalated between Israel, Hezbollah and Iran, the Biden administration said the U.S. is opposed to Israel striking Iran’s nuclear facilities, and a few days later said the U.S. also opposes a strike on Iran’s oil facilities. The White House should instead say “no comment”! **Strategic ambiguity** is a key advantage over adversaries.For example, Trump publicly scolded Kim Jung Un that he’d wipe North Korea off the face of the planet, and then wound up meeting him with Kim in Singapore, Hanoi and Panmunjong. Many Republicans think his unpredictability shows strength, but when he threatened pulling out of NATO to force NATO countries to spend 2% GDP on defense, I think that emboldened Putin.
---
|
---
#### **Peace through economic strength**
In contrast, I remember President Ronald Reagan espoused **“Peace through strength”** , **“Trust but verify”** , and **“Mr. Gorbachev - Tear Down This Wall!”** with a very skillful Secretary of State George Shultz. Our innovation and free-market economy in the 1980s out-competed the Soviet command economy and won the Cold War - it was peace through commercialism. Levis jeans and rock music were as influential with Eastern Europeans looking for freedom and prosperity, as the Strategic Defense Initiative (known as Star Wars) was in intimidating the Soviets into “Glasnost” (openness) and “Perestroika” (restructuring). I took my kids to Berlin just before the pandemic to see the Berlin Wall, where we looked up at a direction sign to the “ _Berlin Mall”_ , and I thought that sign said it all.I grew up here in Menlo Park and remember seeing a headline story in the local Peninsula Times Tribune showing a bulls-eye target on Sunnyvale on Lockheed’s Trident submarine launched missile design facility and the consequent damage to the surrounding mid-Peninsula from a Soviet nuclear warhead. My dad took a tour group in China when the U.S. normalized relations with China after Nixon opened up detente, which Kissinger called the “China card” to play against the Soviets.
#### **Why can’t we create an Iron Dome over Ukraine?**
The Ukraine-Russian war has become a war of attrition, but after two years Europe and America are growing weary as democracies do. So the Western strategy of defensive-only support for Ukraine is perpetuating this war of attrition that only Russia has the appetite for, as Putin intends to recreate the Soviet Union geographically. _**IDEA:**_ In the 90s, the U.S. and NATO established a “No fly zone” over Kosovo to keep the Russian-backed Serbian army from ethnic cleansing the Balkans. **NATO should give Ukraine the Israeli-made** _[**Iron Dome**](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6725092bb928d12e06f81192&u=https%3A%2F%2Fen.wikipedia.org%2Fwiki%2FIron_Dome&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_672309a64acd596429584c7f&l=en-US&s=rPeAqx3tIvkBn6MYKosgxy7FYBg%3D)_**air defense system** to prevent Russian missiles from hitting Ukrainian infrastructure and civilians, and consider**enforcing a No-Fly Zone west of the Dnieper in Ukraine.**. In April and October, the U.S. assisted in a no-fly zone over Israel by shooting down some of the 300 drones, rockets and cruise missiles fired from Iran.

body:
What will we choose?

I think both the presidential and our race are a choice... between _**hope**_ and _**fear.**_ I’m hopeful Democrats can win. We’re running on important policies like protecting fundamental freedoms and an economy that works for everyone. I know that if voters hear that message we win. However, as we saw in 2016, voters aren’t just hearing our positive message. They are inundated with negative ads spewing hate meant to divide us from our neighbors. You only have to listen to the most recent Trump rally to see it. This is why I’m also fearful for our country. What happens if Trump wins? And what if he has control of Congress?
