name: George Logan for Congress
subject: George wanted to pass along this message to you:
body:
This is Annamarie – George Logan’s Campaign Manager. George is knocking doors and turning out voters today but he asked me to pass along this message directly to you.
| |
---
| | | Peter:

This is Annamarie - George Logan's Campaign Manager. George is knocking doors and turning out voters today but he asked me to pass along this message directly to you.

---
| [](https://trk.emails.georgeloganforcongress._lIq01LiJflCow)
---
**_- From the Desk of George Logan - _**

Hello!

It's George here.

I just wanted to take a moment - in the final four days of the election - and personally thank you for all the support this cycle. You really are the backbone of this campaign. Every dollar contributed, survey filled out, or endorsement you've added has made a huge difference.

In 2022, we came within a couple thousand votes of unsetting an entrenched, well-funded incumbent. It hurt when we were that close to victory but ultimately came up short.

**This year is different. I can feel it.**

The voters I talk to are fed up with the dysfunction, chaos, and division that are tearing at the fabric of the country. The list of failures coming out of DC is long and devastating. Prices are up, our border is open, and crime is out of control.

My opponent - Jahana Hayes - voted for all of it. It's her burden to bear for voting 99% of the time with Joe Biden and for being an adjunct member of the far-left Squad.

That's why I am confident that, together, we're going to defeat her in 4 days from right now.

You've already contributed so much to this campaign, and I can't thank you enough for everything you've done. **[Only because others have asked, if you still want to help in these last 96 hours, we are texting/calling/knocking on the doors of undecided voters in CT-05- you can help fund these final Get-Out-The-Vote (GOTV) operations by pitching in a few bucks using this secure link.](https://trk.emails.georgeloganforcongress. "Only because others have asked, if you still want to help in these last 96 hours, we are texting/calling/knocking on the doors of undecided voters in CT-05 – you can help fund these final Get-Out-The-Vote \(GOTV\) operations by pitching in a few bucks using this secure link.") **

Please remember this: You are under NO OBLIGATION to do anymore for this campaign. You've already helped us out tremendously. I only say this because I've been asked how others can help a lot these final days.

Regardless, I want you to know how much I appreciate everything you've done to date. The ONLY reason we've even made it this far is because of folks like you.

_[And from the bottom of my heart, I thank you for that.](https://trk.emails.georgeloganforcongress._8kRO8b0A "And from the bottom of my heart, I thank you for that.")_

Thank you for everything,
George

George Logan
Republican for Congress, CT-05

* * *

**ELECTION COUNTDOWN**
| [](https://trk.emails.georgeloganforcongress.-yFRRFgWKLyEE15UA)

[](https://trk.emails.georgeloganforcongress.-ywDSWup0qeXw)
---

Afro-Latino Republican George Logan is only 3 points behind Squad Democrat Jahana Hayes (49% to 46%). Right now, this race is a TOSS-UP. Control of the House could hinge on this ONE seat, and we are on the front lines of the most important congressional race in the country. name: Nathaniel Moran
subject: The Third Quarter Minuteman Honoree, RNC, and More...
body:
Proud to serve the First District of Texas! | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
# Welcome to the 2024 Third Quarter edition of **The Moran Minuteman**.
This quarterly newsletter is our way of recognizing extraordinary efforts in the First Congressional District of Texas and providing an inside look into what happens behind the scenes in the life of a Congressman.
---
|
---
|
## Congratulations to our Third Quarter Minuteman
When I think of East Texans, I think of the [Minutemen of the Revolutionary War](https://nathanielmoran.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0775eb7c3a967d340caf4e913&id=506d4b5752&e=bbce4dd6ad). Loyal to country and community, dependable, selfless, and ready at a moment's notice, the Minutemen were American heroes who helped turn the tide of the Revolutionary War. **Today's East Texans reflect those traits.** You are patriotic, dependable, and deeply committed to making our communities better.

Each quarter, I will recognize an East Texan who has gone above and beyond in serving our region - someone who epitomizes the identity of a Minuteman. In addition to recognition in the quarterly newsletter, we will send the person a Moran Minuteman t-shirt.

This quarter I had a difficult time choosing just one person to recognize. While visiting with different groups and organizations within the First District of Texas, I decided to highlight some of the wonderful people who give back so much to their communities!

Here's a look at a few of those visits!

---
| | **Republican Women of Gregg County**
Vision: To be an influential grassroots movement of women encompassing all generations and cultures in Gregg County, working to nurture the importance of faith, family and freedom and build strong leaders of tomorrow.
---
|
---
|
---
---
|
---
---
| | **East Texans For Liberty**
Mission and Purpose: To affect public policy at a local, state and national levels consistent with the core values of constitutionally limited government, fiscal responsibility and free markets, to attract, educate, organize, and activate people of all ages to become involved in civic affairs, preserve these values through political action, and to work cooperatively with other live-minded groups.
---
|
---
---
|
---
---
| | **Cass County Republican Town Hall**
Thank you Cass County and surrounding counties for your leadership and influence in the region! We had a great time seeing everyone and giving a legislative update!

---
|
---
|
---
---
| | **GAWTP - Grassroots America - We The People**
A non-partisan organization with a constitutional focus, whose mission is to advance the Cause of Liberty as rooted in limited government, personal responsibility, good citizenship, defense of traditional family values and the free market system, and return of the U.S. Constitution and the Bill fo Rights.
---
|
---
|
---
---

name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: I’m used to being written off
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
I’m used to being written off, Peter.
When I first ran for Congress in Wisconsin, no one thought I could win — especially when an extremely popular challenger jumped into the race.
I remember huddling with one of my staffers at the time, and she said, _“Well Tammy, maybe you want to rethink what you’re doing because it’s going to be tough.”_
I looked her right in the eye and asked, _“Do you think I should wait my turn?”_
The next thing I said was this: **I believe that women have to run — especially when it’s hard — and not wait our turn. We can’t wait until we get a tap on our shoulder or we’ll never get anywhere.**
I ended up winning that race and became the very first woman elected to the House of Representatives from Wisconsin. And it wouldn’t be the last time our team would make history.
When I ran for U.S. Senate in 2012, an incredible team of grassroots supporters like you fought alongside me — even as some people wrote us off. You helped me become the first woman elected to the chamber from our state and the first openly gay Senator in our nation’s history.
In 2018, despite being a top target for national Republicans and enduring over a year of attacks, you stood with me again, and we won.
Time and again, grassroots supporters like you have helped us defy the odds. The battle to protect my seat this year will be no different, with this race being my toughest election yet.
**Eric Hovde and his Republican allies have already spent more than $51 million to buy this seat and recent polls are showing this race in a dead heat. Protecting this seat won’t be easy, but together, I know we can defy the odds once again.**

subject: Anxious about the election?
body:
This awesome new tool will help you turn out progressive voters! | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us8.campaign-archive.com/?e=7e921d898f&u=1c4af7e0c2cf6603f994addd7&id=b3f905b2c6)
---
| | | Hi Peter,
Are you as anxious as I am about the upcoming election? 😬 There is SO much on the line. If you find yourself doom scrolling on your phone for hours...you’re not alone.
But here’s the thing, we can DO something about it. This election is going to come down to who turns out to vote. And all the research says that _the most effective voting messages are the ones we get from people we know._ So you can make a huge difference just by reaching out to your friends and family!
I’ve been using an app called [SwipeBlue](https://parents-together.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c4af7e0c2cf6603f994addd7&id=ed4ec17202&e=7e921d898f) to send voting reminders to my friends, and it makes it so easy. It matches your phone contacts and creates a customized message for you to text out.

#### **You can go to the app store on your phone and search for SwipeBlue or click here:**
---
| |
[Get started](https://parents-together.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c4af7e0c2cf6603f994addd7&id=2a8ba60981&e=7e921d898f)
| I’ve even been reaching out to friends who I haven’t talked to in a while, and it’s been so great to reconnect. One friend invited me to their holiday party!
This election is so close. We can all help get out the vote by reaching out to our networks.
Let’s face it...you’re going to be on your phone anyway (maybe even right NOW? 👀) so you might as well make the most of it!
So just download the SwipeBlue app, and start reaching out to your contacts! You never know...your outreach could be just the nudge someone needed to vote! 💡
---

You can go to the app store on your phone and search for SwipeBlue or click here: | | | I’ve even been reaching out to friends who I haven’t talked to in a while, and it’s been so great to reconnect. One friend invited me to their holiday party! This election is so close. We can all help get out the vote by reaching out to our networks. Let’s face it...you’re going to be on your phone anyway (maybe even right NOW? 👀) so you might as well make the most of it! So just download the SwipeBlue app, and start reaching out to your contacts! You never know...your outreach could be just the nudge someone needed to vote! 💡 | All the best,Nani | | | | | | | | | mailto:advocacy@parents-together.org | | | | Regular actions and updates to support families and help them thrive. name: Lt. Governor Sara Rodriguez
subject: It's never been more important to vote
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Rodriguez for Wisconsin
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/srodriguez-email?refcode=20241101_em_fr_b1_SR_NGP [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/srodriguez-email?refcode=20241101_em_fr_b1_SR_NGP]
Friend, it's Lt. Governor Sara Rodriguez. I'm reaching out one last time before Election Day with one simple reminder:
This is one of the most important elections of our lifetimes.
Wisconsin is one of the most important swing states in the country. Our 10 electoral votes are some of the most important in the country, and it's crucial that we deliver them to Kamala Harris on Election Day.
And at the state level, we have a task that's just as important: flipping the state legislature. The new, fairer maps for this cycle give everyone the chance to win, which makes this the first time in a long time that we can win a majority this November.
When we win next Tuesday, it'll let Governor Evers and I focus on passing our agenda that truly serves the people of Wisconsin rather than fighting back against Republican attempts to bully working-class Wisconsinites.
With just a few days left in this election cycle, it's more important than ever to make your voice heard at the ballot box. Whether that means voting early or voting on Election Day, the most important thing is that you vote. I'll be doing my part this weekend, knocking on as many doors as I can with my team—can you chip in to help us cover the expenses for this last big GOTV push? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/srodriguez-email?refcode=20241101_em_fr_b1_SR_NGP]
CHIP IN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/srodriguez-email?refcode=20241101_em_fr_b1_SR_NGP]
In service,
Lt. Gov Sara Rodriguez
Lt. Gov. Sara Rodriguez, MSN, MPH, RN, was sworn in as Wisconsin’s 46th Lieutenant Governor on January 3, 2023. A working mom, wife, and proud Wisconsinite, Lt. Gov. Rodriguez was elected on November 8, 2022. Before her election, she served in the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Assembly District 13, comprising a portion of Waukesha and Milwaukee Counties. While serving as a state representative, she worked on the Committees on Health, Insurance, Energy and Utilities, and Science, Technology and Broadband.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/srodriguez-email?refcode=20241101_em_fr_b1_SR_NGP [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/srodriguez-email?refcode=20241101_em_fr_b1_SR_NGP]
Lt. Gov. Rodriguez is an experienced healthcare executive who has worked in various leadership roles for over 20 years, including founding her own small business. Prior to serving in the Wisconsin State Assembly, Lt. Gov. Rodriguez was the vice president of Population Health and Integrated Care Management at one of the largest healthcare systems in the Midwest. In this role, she provided strategic direction to the teams that managed population health interventions for risk-based contracts and direct-to-employer products.
Before running for office, Lt. Gov. Rodriguez built a career in public health and population health management. She held positions with public health departments at the local, state, and federal levels, including serving as an epidemic intelligence service officer with the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, the chronic disease director for the state of Colorado, a healthcare systems consultant, and a vice president at a Fortune 100 Company.

body:

Have you made your voting plan yet? Election Day is this Tuesday, November 5th – just 4 days away!

Hey there,
**The U.S. Senate is a country club.** It’s full of millionaires, former business execs, lawyers with Ivy League degrees, and trust fund kids born with so many silver spoons in their mouths that they have no idea the reality for working-class people like me.
**If I defeat my opponent Republican Senator Deb Fischer in November, I will be the poorest member of the U.S. Senate.** I don’t come from money, and I’m not rich. I’m a steamfitter and mechanic who works 50 and 60 hour weeks to give my kids a better life.
**I will be the only senator without a college degree.** After my wife and I found out we were expecting a baby, I had to drop out and kill my dream of hanging a diploma on the wall because my family needed health insurance, diapers, and food on the table.
**I will be the only senator who is a blue-collar, card-carrying, union member.** When Kellogg’s tried to cut our benefits and workers’ pay, we risked it all, went on strike, and walked the picket line for 11 weeks through the bitter cold Nebraska winter. We won and saved hundreds of good-paying jobs – before I was fired for being the union president who led the strike.
There is no one who represents working-class people like me in the U.S. Senate. Which is why this is such big news: **Five brand-new polls show I am narrowly LEADING my opponent Republican Senator Deb Fischer. And FiveThirtyEight now says this is the CLOSEST Senate race in the entire country!**
I’ve taken on a big corporation before and won, and now I’m going to defeat one of the most corporate senators – my opponent Republican Deb Fischer – and win this Senate seat. But I need your help to do it.
**We’ve set a goal of raising another $200,000 before our next fundraising deadline at midnight tonight, but I’m not taking money from corporate PACs like my opponent. If I’m going to defeat Republican Deb Fischer and win this Senate seat, I need grassroots donors like you to give right now:**

clean_body: It’s full of millionaires, formers business execs, lawyers with Ivy League degrees, and trust fund kids born with so many silver spoons in their mouths that they have no idea the reality for working-class people like me. = Hey there, The U.S. Senate is a country club. It’s full of millionaires, former business execs, lawyers with Ivy League degrees, and trust fund kids born with so many silver spoons in their mouths that they have no idea the reality for working-class people like me. If I defeat my opponent Republican Senator Deb Fischer in November, I will be the poorest member of the U.S. Senate. I don’t come from money, and I’m not rich. I’m a steamfitter and mechanic who works 50 and 60 hour weeks to give my kids a better life. I will be the only senator without a college degree. After my wife and I found out we were expecting a baby, I had to drop out and kill my dream of hanging a diploma on the wall because my family needed health insurance, diapers, and food on the table. I will be the only senator who is a blue-collar, card-carrying, union member. When Kellogg’s tried to cut our benefits and workers’ pay, we risked it all, went on strike, and walked the picket line for 11 weeks through the bitter cold Nebraska winter. We won and saved hundreds of good-paying jobs – before I was fired for being the union president who led the strike. There is no one who represents working-class people like me in the U.S. Senate. Which is why this is such big news: Five brand-new polls show I am narrowly LEADING my opponent Republican Senator Deb Fischer. And FiveThirtyEight now says this is the CLOSEST Senate race in the entire country! This is the Inquiry Sent below:
Dear Editors and Investigative Journalists of Connecticut's Major News & Media Outlets and Other Independent News Channel Outlets:
The Doctor Michael Goldstein for Congress Campaign for the 4th Congressional District has received numerous inquiries and concerns about Yonkers Contracting as the Primary Contractor for most CT DOT projects throughout Fairfield County and other parts of the state.
We see these trucks everywhere every night along the campaign trail when the roads are being worked on for improvements.
The concerns they raise are seeing New York License plates and why these are not Connecticut trucks.

Have you looked into:

1. How are these contracts awarded?
2. If an out-of-state contractor is hired, will it use Connecticut Union Construction workers and other ancillary Connecticut residents to participate in the construction or are all these workers New York as well?
3. If an out-of-state contractor is hired, will it use local suppliers of various materials or are all these suppliers New York as well?
4. Whether all contracts are awarded to the lowest bidder?
5. Are local contractors considered if their bid is slightly higher?
6. How is a contractor rewarded or penalized by its previous project for change order usage as the winners always seem to be the same?
7. The percentage of payrolls to Connecticut residents (if any)?
8. The benefit to local communities and economies in Connecticut if a local contractor is awarded the contract?
9. The benefits of contractor profits being re-invested into the local economy rather than exporting profits outside of CT for the out-of-state contractor and its out-of-state suppliers?
10. Additional Fees such as fuel surcharges and other distance based issues on logistics?

As Climate Change and Health Hazards associated with slow-moving traffic are also major concerns, are the following also included in the calculation:
1. The environmental impact of greenhouse gas based on travel distance of workers and equipment out of state to the project site?
2. The additional congestion of the workforce commuting to the construction site and how it will disrupt traffic for commuters?

We have been concerned about the I-95 traffic and the challenges to the Fairfield County corridor and now a project is starting. We saw the Yonkers Contracting banner and also wondered why there are no Connecticut Companies that win these bids.
While most of the highway funds are from the Federal Government, it is still Connecticut taxpayer funds as CT has traditionally received only 70 cents back on each federal dollar.
As a candidate for Congress in Connecticut and campaigning on improving the Fairfield County corridor, it is not just about improving the roads, but having a lasting impact on the local economies of Fairfield County and surrounding counties that keep federally spent dollars in Connecticut.
Some Links we have briefly assembled as this is really investigative reporting:

[https://www.yonkerscontractingco.com/stamford-parking](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b1b72f22-dc20-4f0b-bb40-c46fb871a308?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[https://newyork.news12.com/sick-of-backups-on-i-95-new-project-promises-relief](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4fb34e9a-65c8-4294-a642-5b73b3afd819?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

The voters want to know why tax dollars leave for out-of-state contractors when they know there are contractors in the State (not necessarily in the Congressional District) to do the work.
We would appreciate your prompt attention to this matter as this is a major concern for our Voters.
**Traffic** , **Infrastructure** , **Climate Change** and **Health** are on the Ballot and the voter should be informed. Connecticut has also some of the highest costs per mile for road repair and construction and our constituents are concerned about inefficient use of taxpayer funds at the state and local level as poor spending hurts each resident in the pocketbook.
We are thoroughly concerned about these issues.

We just can’t afford to lose Susan; she is more than a good congressperson and a certain vote for the things we believe in.

| Peter,

I know by this time, with a week to go before the election, you are probably sick and tired of getting requests from campaigns. So, I will make this last one cognizant of the fact that I have asked you to do so much in this pivotal election.

The Pennsylvania Democrats Congressional Delegation improved immeasurably in 2018 when we elected the “Fab Four” of Madeleine Dean, Mary Scanlon, Chrissy Houlahan, and Susan Wild.

Fortunately, three of the four are in districts where their good work makes it easy for them to win re-election. But one of them, Susan Wild, is in a district that will always be a swing district because it is nearly equally populated by democrats, republicans, and independents.

[_**So I am asking you to help one more time and give Susan the money she will need on election day and get it to her as quickly as possible.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96342976/509692352/-1389333692?refcode=BLU_EM_SWC_2024-11-01_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODczMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZjEzNmE5MS03OTk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Kg5uIQErmIWJBLPJOqBQQLyK-Hm755fd3mD94iy6KGA=)

body:
Politics often leaves a bitter taste in our mouths. It's no wonder so many of us approach it with disdain.

| | | | _Please see a special message from our sponsor. [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=af4127aacaf84173ab9334ecacd74386&_e=W_D_O70uniFI24g41C7UyL37CXwDBk0c4Dk_VisoS8GkVuG70SohKyQnBoSNJLM-PYlW1OEqGhFFszX9TgEWhVOntgwPI30zH0lGFFBfyvD5U_iWNvprckImxbxRlgx_byxK9dhsBYVf_ACmK7TBwjwijY-GZCdK6Gdy33zW6LKikhpo0nkQ3QIYZke2LAsqomz7rJCgmn2NAcSLb4miFB4TusWVevzompyPv3ud7Oq1QK_9ZhgbQOhzG2LpgiOE5gVMNIRmFnqQ4r3CPRBGTE2KKx1TbdgAFwWqkG4y2jkE-8fE7C-IBS_6SRkqlyvm2HIJAHg6AMcwTTtHIStEuUId0KqAw6doqb5ANRnY1m5zyj5CadIEKYWpnlaSe5y0IRCcbFr61x2UD5GBCFqMQg%3D%3D)
Dear Friend,

Politics often leaves a bitter taste in our mouths. It's no wonder so many of us approach it with disdain. The endless mudslinging, pandering to special interest groups, and policies shaped by poll numbers rather than deeply held convictions make politics seem like a world Christians should avoid.

Yet, as Christians, we can't ignore the rapid unraveling of our culture or remain passive in the face of the evil we see around us. The Bible tells us that our citizenship is in heaven (Philippians 3:20) and that we are aliens and strangers in this world (1 Peter 2:11). But does that mean we should leave governing to unbelievers? Should we invest our time in influencing what seems transitory at best?

The answer is simple: Jesus commanded us to be the salt and light of the world (Matthew 5:13-14). As Christians, we are called to preserve the spiritual and moral fabric of society wherever God has placed us. And that includes influencing every aspect of our culture--entertainment, business, education, and yes, even government.
---

#
## ****
## **Quick List**
This is a long Newsletter with a lot of info, but I hope you'll take your time and look it over. If you only have a moment, here's the takeaway, this is our chance to build something new in PA and in our political system. Here's how you can help in the next 4 days. **** Links: [Volunteer With Forward National](https://home.forwardparty.com/volunteer_2024?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_november_newsletter&n=1) [Request Forward Materials](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=Cau9QZYSrELuaBTd-UPVTqHj5ypwcVC4lINLBKQ1dRWcq0jNIi1AnxdAILAhhSmx&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_november_newsletter&n=2)
## **Pennsylvanians want what we're offering!**
What is our 2 Party Political system producing? Division. Demonization. Dysfunction. This is a great time to tell the people around you about a new party that wants to address these issues. Everyone who has been working to spread the word about Forward will tell you same thing, "People like what we're doing". When you tell someone that we want to give them more choices, and break the stalemate in our politics, they have a hard time believing it's real. And then you get to say, "You can make it real." We've been working on this for 2 years and we're not going to stop no matter what. But we can do a lot more a recognized minor party. To get that we need either Eric Settle or Chris Foster to get 2% of the vote. Political conversation is something most people have come to dread, but I promise you, this is different. The people around you will vote for Forward Party candidates, someone just has to ask them. Please be that someone.
### **Working the Polls**
Voters will be lined up to vote on Tuesday without any idea who they're supporting for AG or Treasurer. If you tell them know why you're supporting our candidates, you can easily sway others. If you're not comfortable talking to strangers, you could also help us by putting up yard signs near the polling places near you. We have volunteers giving their time to do this kind of work from across the state, please help in your area. Email us at pennsylvania@forwardparty.com to learn more.
* * *
## **Canvassing Opportunities in Philadelphia**
Led by the legendary Nancy Hanks, every Saturday leading up to this election you could find Nancy and a rotating group of volunteers getting the word out about Forward and our tremendous candidates. Forward candidate Eric Settle has been known to join and they were even recently joined by Forward Co-Chair, Governor Christine Todd Whitman. To Join Nancy, feel free to reach out to her directly at [hanksnan@gmail.com](mailto:hanksnan@gmail.com) or just come to the corner of 18th and Walnut from 9:30am to 12:30pm on Saturday. The National Forward Party has chosen Philadelphia as the location for their Election Night Watch Party. Use the link below and RSVP for more details.[](https://home.forwardparty.com/2024_election_night?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_november_newsletter&n=3) We have an active community on Slack, join to keep up with all the conversations after the election.[
](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=OO1xB82Dwc0SwW5xslNAt5demYUjnvMsNObg_2SsnH4C04dQQgB9BZ02TA7y9H7t-4vbxkv79HHUmZ6qj3hodUR-7alEp57O08vr8cfcTeFUloFbffPqlZP8qsSt5ozRpo-ljG0b_nmp5HGri8eilg&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_november_newsletter&n=4) Join us November 18th at 8pm for our Monthly Statewide call. You'll have things you want to talk about, We will to! [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=MtBLw57MCBnd28lIl741u2Dt1n837RKwUJg_KtN7MY7q18JSzxr4IIh1PTMDpFPRQGa3i-p7rAuoG8kynt2Tiw&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_november_newsletter&n=5) **Click below to read the articles******[](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=_KeSraPW0gSlxEBMOvJrEouH4SjeZmYtvTWulgNFAfZTDhoQVQ2fY9EX_128kAhR&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_november_newsletter&n=6) [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=Eyc1l625BY9jvV9H6iRJefDdTm4YIsTX07wmg-za5NAVzeXFyy7xdMqlFy7hVcjAcyin41P2fZVXvmgrr6t2hCIbDE0_YM-QWrKZE_cESTCJqkyCB2b5hdIk1B9y2qiqzkBfBIcRkSnzy7g8APQCvs4Zou0xfj1OM0F8tipMEfskjBsLjmeaR7iHWFexiuzkuN7594U91Y7RfII6dqEQIw&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_november_newsletter&n=7) [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=V7SejdAfq_S5peXuNGcE_VGnmYIJVo6a_Z7isKPClcoDk5ucqLPPmlugzZu72DsDC1iI6aQj6kPNVH-5ZkLqt4RZ3ngoXDAgTaDSlnZIU1qoIfgdWUJYGXAiMdUN0JmT60-hupL83-ikIkIocEVtww&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_november_newsletter&n=8)

Team -- the New York Times literally has the video recordings of the zoom calls hosted by major vote suppressors as they plan how to challenge voters and try to get our votes thrown out:
Image of "For years, opponents of voting rights have huddled in video meetings to talk about remaking democracy and plan for the election." [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/NYT_Suppressive-election-network-video-topper-640w_Small.gif]
Their calls for " election integrity " are little more than a costume they throw over their voter suppression efforts to make them appear legitimate.
They're coming for our votes, not just this year but for the future as well. Please, RUSH $25 or more right now to help us defend the right to vote and fight back against their voter suppression plans >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=110124_3&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=110124_3&amount=25]
The Atlantic: What Election Integrity Really Means [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=110124_3&amount=25]
Sometimes figuring out what opponents of voting rights are saying feels like you need a translation device, Team. But this one has gotten pretty easy -- for the vote suppressors, "election integrity" means elections they win .
Despite no evidence of widespread fraud and millions of taxpayer dollars wasted investigating false claims, a relative few cases and convictions have happened, despite the avalanche of voter suppression legislation passed since 2017 . Florida alone spent millions of dollars to create a new division of state police and run investigations into voters, only to find 20 formerly incarcerated voters who voted before their rights had been restored. 20 out of a state of nearly 14 million registered voters.
Yet these opponents of voting rights continue to spread lies and misinformation. They know that by passing these laws in states they control they are able to shave off enough potential voters to make sure their suppressive candidates win. They want us scared to vote and scared to support our fellow citizens voting. We can't let them win.
We must fight back against their rhetoric, their lies, and their suppressive legislation. Fuel our efforts to defend the right to vote with $25 or more to and restore faith in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=110124_3&amount=25]

body:
Sign up for our upcoming phone bank to support gun safety.
#

Friend,
Don't miss your chance to join us TONIGHT for a special phone bank opportunity!
**Join us[at 6 pm ET/3 pm PT](https://go.giffords.org/go/58003?t=1&akid=9350%2E3935704%2EF0qqLC) for the Gun Violence Prevention Voters for Harris-Walz Phone Bank.**
This is a unique opportunity to hear from former Congresswoman **Gabby Giffords** and Congresswoman **Lucy McBath** from Georgia, two women who have had their lives turned upside down by gun violence. Your voice matters in this fight, and this event is a powerful way to connect with others who are dedicated to preventing gun violence.
**[RSVP](https://go.giffords.org/go/58002?t=2&akid=9350%2E3935704%2EF0qqLC)**
Thank you for your commitment to this important cause—**together, we can make a difference!**
We hope you’ll join us tonight.
In solidarity,
The team at GIFFORDS
PS: Help us spread the message online—use this [**Social Media Toolkit**](https://go.giffords.org/go/57507?t=3&akid=9350%2E3935704%2EF0qqLC) to share how Team Harris-Walz is fighting to make our communities safer. Your voice can inspire others to join the cause!

body:
Lawson-Remer: Missed Meetings, Missed Votes, and Missed Opportunities to Address Our Challenges | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/3b0f9d762537/lawson-remer-missed-meetings-missed-votes-and-missed-opportunities-to-address-our-challenges?e=784f78234b)

| | |
# Dear Friend,
#
When you’re elected to represent the people, showing up isn’t optional—it’s a basic responsibility. When I was Mayor, I showed up every day and met with my staff, the City Council, and department leaders to ensure the City was doing its best to address our challenges.
What’s important? Showing up to work. Yet, Vice Chair Terra Lawson-Remer has failed to attend a single meeting of the homelessness task force, despite claiming homelessness is her top priority. This task force isn’t just a title; it’s a critical opportunity to address our county’s homelessness crisis.
Under Lawson-Remer’s watch, [homelessness](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=8234edce5f&e=784f78234b) and related [deaths](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=7cea6485b4&e=784f78234b) have reached unprecedented levels. But instead of engaging, she’s missed meetings and critical votes—neglecting her duties and abandoning core responsibilities.
It’s not just her—her staff has failed to show up as well. Lawson-Remer has even admitted that her representatives [haven’t attended meetings](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=78d158e2cf&e=784f78234b), leaving important issues unaddressed. In any other job, failing to attend mandatory meetings would be grounds for termination.
But when it comes to serving our communities, she expects a pass?
**San Diego deserves a leader who is accountable, dedicated and, most importantly, present.** I understand the urgency of San Diego’s homelessness crisis and have a track record of hands-on leadership, proven solutions, and a transparent commitment to our community. I won’t sit on the sidelines or turn a blind eye to the issues that affect us all just to collect a paycheck.
Let’s work to address the pressing challenges we face as a county—together. I humbly ask for your support.
Sincerely,
Kevin Faulconer

Rodas was a federal employee for more than 20 years. While serving at the Pomona Fairplex Emergency Intake Site in Pomona, California, Tara volunteered to help place Unaccompanied Children with Sponsors in the United States. Tara saw firsthand how a lack of transparency, oversight, flawed policies, and deficiencies in HHS’ Unaccompanied Children Program resulted in children being placed with suspicious Sponsors and suspected trafficking rings throughout the United States. Welcome to the first edition of _The Feel Good Flyover!_ Looking for some good news to kick off your weekend? We've got you covered. ## West Virginia Miners Move Mountains
Coal miners from West Virginia, nicknamed the ["West Virginia Boys"](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyE0DGO8yAUBODT4O5F8ExMKCj-hi5_u6WF4WGzwsYyxFFuv_JeYLuRRvo0mq_n-HQpp23-71YycY5ji2VEjhKEAC7G_Sh1J99G2QUTiZD6joxQPZcPNSjdLUY8ehmFJI8qeq1QB45BhknfCe9-Ul0yFygEF-IhNaobEvIwaB-ljiTcwCSnkFo5bt8lbW2hmD_lpOPmy9pls7S2V9b_Y2gZ2u2zl9quiqG9YIZW8CsrhvZVYaN3ZWjfVBucDqbyqTC9Ug5wFBegFlgo00ZwJt_SWsG7DeYCS1mJoe0OE_Z3yjnVQTHJ59Wl_Luk_XHQafAnAAD__0IyahI) by grateful locals, moved a mountain in late October to rebuild a crucial 2.7-mile stretch of Hurricane Helene-ravaged Highway 64 in North Carolina. In just three days, they completed what officials said would take months. Using a bulldozer and two excavators balanced on the newly widened banks of the Broad River, they maneuvered a 20-ton granite boulder into place to restore access. Using a bulldozer and two excavators balanced on the newly widened banks of the Broad River, they maneuvered a 20-ton granite boulder into place to restore access. Take a look at the . Dear Peter,

**We are heartbroken and outraged. When we say that abortion bans place real lives in danger, we aren't being hyperbolic.**

Today, ProPublica published its second heartbreaking story in three days exposing the deadly consequences of Texas’s restrictive abortion laws. This time, the report tells of [**Nevaeh Crain**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96348000/509707068/-764321502?sourceid=1150009&utm_campaign=25emcab-1003aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=abortionbans&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OTczNjMyZi04Mjk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Qo1-7-69SPbgFwbhpEOIQ_iCmKsIRmCegmw0xArVW1g=&emci=07567f41-cd97-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=8973632f-8298-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=954237), an 18-year-old who tragically died after three visits to Texas emergency rooms. Despite her worsening condition, doctors delayed critical care for nearly 20 hours, fearing repercussions under Texas's abortion ban.

Nevaeh's story joins a growing list. Earlier this week, ProPublica reported on [**Josseli Barnica**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96348001/509707069/2052342378?sourceid=1150009&utm_campaign=25emcab-1003aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=abortionbans&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OTczNjMyZi04Mjk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Qo1-7-69SPbgFwbhpEOIQ_iCmKsIRmCegmw0xArVW1g=&emci=07567f41-cd97-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=8973632f-8298-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=954237), a young mother who died after enduring a 40-hour wait for miscarriage care—care that was restrained by Texas's vigilante abortion law, S.B. 8. She, like Nevaeh, lost her life because healthcare providers were beholden to state legislation rather than medical reality.

**In Texas alone, pregnancy-related deaths have risen by 56% since the 2021 abortion ban went into effect.** Laws like S.B. 8 make pregnancy riskier, impacting anyone who might face a complication. Even in emergencies, doctors are prevented from providing lifesaving care. And adding insult to injury, Texas's response has been to appoint an anti-abortion advocate to an important state committee that oversees maternal mortality—a move that further endangers those at risk.

**These tragedies are not isolated.** In September, ProPublica reported on the deaths of [**Amber Nicole Thurman**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96348002/509707070/1815519483?sourceid=1150009&utm_campaign=25emcab-1003aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=abortionbans&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OTczNjMyZi04Mjk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Qo1-7-69SPbgFwbhpEOIQ_iCmKsIRmCegmw0xArVW1g=&emci=07567f41-cd97-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=8973632f-8298-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=954237) and [**Candi Miller**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96348003/509707071/-584315244?sourceid=1150009&utm_campaign=25emcab-1003aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=abortionbans&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OTczNjMyZi04Mjk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Qo1-7-69SPbgFwbhpEOIQ_iCmKsIRmCegmw0xArVW1g=&emci=07567f41-cd97-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=8973632f-8298-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=954237), who both lost their lives after not receiving timely abortion care in Georgia. **Nevaeh, Josseli, Amber, and Candi should be here today.**

This is why we fight. Abortion bans are causing irreparable harm, pain, and heartbreak across the U.S. **And with you by our side, we won’t back down.**

Healthy pregnancy experiences are possible when we invest in reproductive freedom. **That is why we work so hard to support our clients who offer patient-centered medical care, and advocate for laws that allow people to receive the full range of services they may need throughout their lives.**

Thank you for standing with us. Your support fuels our determination to prevent more lives from being lost to such injustice.

Onward together,

Hi Peter, As we stand on the cusp of the 2024 Election, I find myself reminiscing on the windy path that led me here, in Congress representing my home district. When my boys were young, my husband and I were both working full-time. As soon as I got off the night shift from the Chapel Hill Police Department at 7am, I would go straight to my sons’ classrooms to volunteer. Not only did this serve as an opportunity for me to spend more precious time with my children, but it opened my eyes to the social disparities affecting students firsthand, especially Black and brown kids, in the classroom. **I couldn’t stand by as students were being underserved, so after doing everything I could do as a volunteer — I ran for School Board.** On the School Board, I fought tooth and nail for better funding for our schools. But eventually, **I knew I had to run for Orange County Commissioner to make concrete changes.** As Orange County Commissioner, I championed the construction of two schools, two senior centers, and affordable housing initiatives — **but knew the next step to securing long-term progress for our children’s and communities’ future was running for State House.** I championed legislation for women, voting rights, and environmental protection. **But, when I could do nothing more as State Senator, I ran for Congress.** I got into this line of work in pursuit of building a better life for my community and followed my heart throughout every single step. [Now, there’s still SO much more I can do. In just 4 days, you can send me back to Congress and keep building progress for NC-04. clean_body: Can I tell you about my journey to Congress? If you’d like to unsubscribe, | | Hi Peter, As we stand on the cusp of the 2024 Election, I find myself reminiscing on the windy path that led me here, in Congress representing my home district. When my boys were young, my husband and I were both working full-time. As soon as I got off the night shift from the Chapel Hill Police Department at 7am, I would go straight to my sons’ classrooms to volunteer. Not only did this serve as an opportunity for me to spend more precious time with my children, but it opened my eyes to the social disparities affecting students firsthand, especially Black and brown kids, in the classroom. I couldn’t stand by as students were being underserved, so after doing everything I could do as a volunteer — I ran for School Board. On the School Board, I fought tooth and nail for better funding for our schools. But eventually, I knew I had to run for Orange County Commissioner to make concrete changes. As Orange County Commissioner, I championed the construction of two schools, two senior centers, and affordable housing initiatives — but knew the next step to securing long-term progress for our children’s and communities’ future was running for State House. I championed legislation for women, voting rights, and environmental protection. But, when I could do nothing more as State Senator, I ran for Congress. I got into this line of work in pursuit of building a better life for my community and followed my heart throughout every single step. = | If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process now. | = | = | = | = | = | = I’m so grateful to have you alongside me on this journey, Peter. — Valerie | = Paid for by Foushee for Congress Valerie Foushee for Congress PO Box 16446 Chapel Hill, NC 27516 United States If you would like to unsubscribe, You can also =.

Let’s win this, folks.
With all my gratitude,
Lateefah

If everyone gives just a bit more than they typically would, we'll raise more than enough to hit these goals and be ready for whatever comes our way in these final days.
#

Peter —
Ruben reached out this morning about an ambitious goal: $1.5 million raised between now and midnight on Election Day.
We’re hoping you can lend a hand before then, because this final goal is critical. Here’s why:
As our fundraising fell off, Kari Lake’s picked up. She escalated her advertising alongside the outside groups backing her up, and spent millions of dollars attacking Ruben as voters started returning their ballots. We saw this race tighten, gradually at first, and then earlier this week, two polls showed us TIED with Lake.
The timing couldn’t be worse. We’ve got to meet the moment here, but our fundraising hasn’t picked up yet.
The way we see it, there are two options ahead of us:
1. We either need more people to chip in.
2. Or we need everyone who chips in to give a little more than they usually would.

Most people give $10 or so the first time they donate. But today, we’re asking you to chip in $20.24. If you can give that much, it would really help us make up some ground.

| | _**Final Push Towards Victory!**_
---
Friends, We’re in the final push for this election! Now is the time to ensure Republicans get out and vote. Our work has been building toward this moment, and every single vote matters in securing victory. Last week, we celebrated surpassing 400,000 voter contacts, and now we’ve hit over 450,000 contacts through door-to-door efforts and phone banking. Let’s keep this momentum strong through Election Day! Make sure you go out and vote and bring friends and family with you!
On Election Day itself, we encourage everyone to participate in a phone bank with local parties or volunteers in your area to help make those last-minute contacts. If you want to help out please reach out to your local party leaders to get involved!

How BIOS password exposure could threaten election integrity
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Happy Friday,
ONLY 4 DAYS UNTIL ELECTION DAY! I'm curious, do you think we'll know the results on November 5th? Reply to this email with your thoughts.

This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, November 1, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[How BIOS password exposure could threaten election integrity](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Election security is key to a constitutional republic by, for, and of the people. Each part of the voting system should be designed to prevent interference.
BIOS passwords are vital to this security. They are the first defense against unauthorized access to a voting machine’s core settings.
Recent concerns have arisen around how the exposure of BIOS passwords might allow bad actors to manipulate voting systems. Cyber security professionals argue this could create risks even without physical access to the machines. It’s important to consider how such exposure could disrupt elections.
The BIOS (Basic Input/Output System) controls a machine’s basic operations. It includes hardware settings and connectivity options.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ELECTION MUST-READS 🗳️**
[**Ganahl: Exposing Colorado’s election failures, how citizen pressure uncovered what officials tried to hide**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY HEIDI GANAHL | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 31** _During my run as the GOP Nominee for Governor in 2022, I talked to voters across Colorado that didn’t trust our elections. 25% of Republicans didn’t vote. After the race, I decided to dig in and see if I could find a way to restore trust for voters in the process._
__
[**Browning: Why voting the down-ballot is critical in 2024**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY LINDY BROWNING | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 31** _It’s election season 2024. No one in America is unaware of that fact. Election news is wall to wall on every TV station, every newspaper, podcast and social media platform. The tribalism is exhausting and it’s very real._____
[**Final take in 3rd District: One candidate has misled with deception, half-truths and lies; we support vote for Hurd**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY RMV EDITORIAL BOARD | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 31** _Adam Frisch and the Democrats are at it again. In Colorado Congressional District 3, once again the Frisch campaign, in cahoots with the Colorado Democrats, is spending money and sending flyers to voters in support of a third-party candidate who can’t win._ __
|
---
**[Trump Campaign calls for action over Secretary Griswold security breach in Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Trump campaign has called for action from Colorado Secretary of State Jena Griswold after a reported security breach exposed BIOS passwords for voting equipment statewide, which could allow unauthorized modifications.
* The campaign demands that Griswold identify affected counties, implement a new Trusted Build for the systems, and conduct fresh Logic and Accuracy tests to ensure election integrity.
* The Trump campaign warns that while these actions may disrupt the election process, they are essential for maintaining security and trust in Colorado’s voting system.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Graham: A vote for Trump is a vote to restore freedom and opportunity in America](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) ** BY ELLEN GRAHAM, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_I’m a single suburban soccer mom and I’m voting for Donald J. Trump. Well, my children play baseball and golf, but you get it._
_Raised staunchly conservative in Northern Colorado, I was liberal for more years than I’d like to admit, but it’s 2024 and I have a full-time job, two teenagers, including one in private school thanks to more failed public schools. I own a middle-class home in a safe neighborhood. Launching my sons into opportunity is my American Dream._
_We can no longer run away from what our country has become. Just look at the streets of downtown Denver with the needles, feces and encampments. Oh well, big city problems, they say. Go to Aurora, long a bastion for legal immigrants and the working class, where now it’s OK by 9 News standards for just a few apartment buildings to be taken over by a violent gang of illegals from Venezuela. Just a few years ago people cheered for burning down cities because Black Lives Mattered, but now Aurora lives don’t matter at all._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[In sprint to Election Day, millions are being spent on Colorado’s ranked-choice voting proposal](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Millions of dollars have been spent in support of Colorado's ranked-choice voting proposal (Proposition 131), with major contributors like Chevron, Colorado Chamber of Commerce, and Kent Thiry backing the initiative heavily, raising over $15 million.
* Opposition to Proposition 131, largely from two groups, First Choice Counts and Voter Rights Colorado, has raised less than $500,000 collectively, showcasing a significant funding disparity in the campaign.
* Other key ballot measures, such as Amendment 79 on abortion rights, Proposition 127 on banning trophy hunting, and Amendment 80 on school choice, have also seen substantial fundraising, highlighting the high stakes and financial investment in Colorado's 2024 election ballot issues.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[J.D. Vance and Joe Rogan perfectly deconstruct the ‘radical religion’ of the transgender movement](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE FEDERALIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* J.D. Vance and Joe Rogan discussed the "radical religion" of the modern transgender movement, critiquing what they view as extreme ideological beliefs driving the movement.
* They argued that certain radical beliefs are often shielded from scrutiny, drawing parallels between these ideologies and religious faith practices.
* Vance and Rogan expressed concerns over the influence of these beliefs on children, especially regarding gender-affirming medical procedures, and questioned the motivations behind promoting such practices.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Trump sues CBS News for $10 billion after ‘editing’ Kamala Harris’ 60 Minutes interview](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DAILY MAIL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Former President Donald Trump has filed a $10 billion lawsuit against CBS News, accusing the network of manipulating Kamala Harris's responses in a "60 Minutes" interview to make her appear more favorable and credible before the 2024 election.
* Trump's legal team argues that the edits in Harris's interview were intentionally misleading, distorting her views and creating a biased portrayal aimed at benefiting the Democratic Party.
* CBS News declined to release the full unedited transcript, which Trump’s attorneys had requested, claiming that the network's changes have led to significant misinformation and confusion among the public.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Allen& Melanie Fuller: Preserve Colorado charter schools with ‘yes’ vote on Amendment 80](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY ALLEN & MELANIE FULLER | COMMENTARY | NOVEMBER 1** ****_As a husband and wife who both serve on the boards of different charter schools, and as parents of three students currently in K-12 schools in Colorado, we fully support not only Amendment 80, but also the incredible opportunity and personalization school choice creates._****
****
**[Prop. KK is a 6.5% tax on gun owners, firearm retailers that with local tax is ‘more like 30%’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | OCTOBER 31** _Proposition KK has turned Colorado’s gun stores like Jerry’s Outdoor Sports into the front line of a battle over 2nd Amendment rights._
[**Colorado Republicans call for Griswold’s resignation amid security breach**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | OCTOBER 30** _In response to the recent leak of election system passwords by Secretary of State Jena Griswold’s office, Colorado House Republicans issued a call for her resignation._[****](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)__

Chuck Schumer and the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee are now jumping into this race to rescue endangered career politician Martin Heinrich.

**They’re funneling out-of-state dollars into New Mexico to buy up precious advertising time during the final weeks and days before Election Day.**

They know they were completely caught off guard when I entered this race and have been watching nervously as we’ve gradually caught up to Heinrich in the polls.

Now, they can’t stand to sit by any longer and are frantically trying to stop our upward momentum.

With New Mexico being one of the smallest states and cheapest media markets in the 2024 fight for the Senate, the money they’ve raised from West and East Coast liberal elites stretches much further here, _which means they can do A LOT more damage with much less._

**Nella Domenici**
Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: Sacrifices.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE
body:
[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1001&akid=4435%2E35263%2EbzyJWt ]TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE

Peter, I have a
personal story I’d like to share with you.

Growing up, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months
in the hospital.

When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, wanted to make sure I
was protected in case I got sick again. But they couldn’t find any
insurance policies that would cover me in the future.

Not from any insurer. Not at any price.

That meant my grandparents had to pay for my health care out of pocket,
and they had to make significant sacrifices to do so — all because I had a
pre-existing condition.

I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried that I might fall ill
again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care.

No one should ever have to go through that. But my story is not
unique, Peter, and
I knew they weren’t the only ones. That’s why I got into public service.

I’m one of 133 million Americans who have the label "pre-existing
condition" attached to our care — and before the Affordable Care Act was
passed, many of us could be denied coverage.

Now, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based
on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and wrote the
amendment to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan
up to age 26. And when I meet with young people across Wisconsin, almost
every hand in the room goes up when I ask who is on their parent’s health
insurance.

So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health
care and threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions —
including my opponent Eric Hovde, who called my amendment a “stupid idea”
and said young people on their parent’s health insurance need to “grow up
and move on.”

If Eric Hovde flips this seat and secures the Senate majority for
Republicans, the ACA will be on the chopping block and countless Americans
could find themselves in a place where insurance companies are putting
profits over people.

That’s not right. And that’s why I need your help to defeat him.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-nov24.ANyQo7&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20241101_AM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=4435%2E35263%2EbzyJWt ]I’ve fought against Republicans’ efforts to repeal the ACA before, and
I won’t back down now. Peter,
will you make a donation to my reelection
campaign to support my fight to protect and expand access to affordable
health care?

clean_body: Democrats are panicking and throwing everything they have at me in the home stretch. | | | | | | Peter, The polls that have been done on our race show us with a small but consistent lead. My opponent April Delaney's attacks are becoming more and more unhinged as we race toward election day. She dropped millions of her own money into the race the other day. Her negative ads about me are blanketing the airwaves. Maryland's left-wing governor Wes Moore is getting involved, pouring on millions more in the final days. April Delaney has fundraised with the likes of Hillary Clinton and Hakeem Jeffries in the past few weeks. | "Help Us Buy More Commercial Time TODAY!" | And now with such a few days left, she’s begging her army of Leftist, out-of-state megadonors to give even more money to put her over the top. This race can still go either way. It will be extremely close. But if we don't fight back with OUR POSITIVE MESSAGE on the economy, border and cost of living, we'll be buried by her onslaught of lies and negativity. Thursday morning, House Majority Leader Steve Scalise said that my race was one of the TOP 5 IN THE COUNTRY. November 1, 2024
Contact: Duane Dichiara

| **Local Democrat Leaders Endorse Congressman Duarte’s Re-Election Campaign**
---
| | **Merced —** Local Democratic leaders have endorsed Congressman John Duarte’s re-election campaign, highlighting his commitment to working across party lines to deliver results for the Central Valley.

Democratic endorsements include:
* San Joaquin County Sheriff Patrick Withrow (D)
* Kerman Mayor Maria Pacheco (D)
* Mendota Mayor Victor Martinez (D)
* San Joaquin Mayor Julia Hernandez (D)
* Dos Palos Councilman Thomas Pigg (D)
* Firebaugh Councilman Freddy Valdez (D)
* Firebaugh Councilman Brady Jenkins (D)
* Firebaugh Councilman Felipe Perez (D)
* Huron Councilwoman Arelly Arellano (D)
* Lathrop Councilwoman Minnie Diallo (D)
* Madera Councilman Jose Rodriguez (D)

_“I’ve built a track record of working with both Democrats and Republicans to get things done for the Valley. Whether it’s lowering costs, securing water for our farmers, or improving public safety, I’m ready to work with anyone to get things done,”_ said Congressman Duarte. _“I’ve had the pleasure of working with these Democratic elected officials over the past two years, and I’m grateful for their support in my re-election campaign.”_

For more information about John Duarte and the campaign, please visit www.JohnDuarteforCongress.com. ###

Hi Peter. Four days to go. We've made it to the final stretch. I'm so proud of Tim. I'm so proud of this team. I want you to know that, but our work isn't over yet: **[In these final four days before Election Day, I'm asking you to volunteer to reach voters in your community.](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1218?utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241101_b17_gww_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&t=2&akid=233%2E2563979%2E5UnF2l)** | | [VOLUNTEER](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1218?utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241101_b17_gww_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&t=3&akid=233%2E2563979%2E5UnF2l)
---
My mom used to say: _“Do the work that’s in front of you.”_ She was asking me to look around, and see how I might serve. How I might contribute.
**For the next four days,_this_ is the work in front of you.**
Volunteer. Bring a friend. Have conversations in parking lots. Make calls. Knock doors. Bake cookies for those people who are making calls and knocking doors.
Let's do every single thing we can, and let's do it together. That is the way we win.
**I can't say enough how important it is to remind everyone that your vote is your voice. The margins are so close that each one of us stepping up to volunteer truly makes a difference.**

As a voter in Pennsylvania, one of the most critical states of this election, your support is all the more important. Peter, One of my favorite parts of election season is running into someone who is wearing their “I voted” sticker. If I’m in the grocery store and catch a glimpse of a fellow shopper with a sticker, I’ll give a little thumbs up from across the produce section. I’ve even been known to shout, “I like your sticker!” to a stranger as they pass on the sidewalk. And, Peter, if I see you out at a bar and you have your sticker on — game over. clean_body: A small form of celebration of this great democracy | Peter, One of my favorite parts of election season is running into someone who is wearing their “I voted” sticker. If I’m in the grocery store and catch a glimpse of a fellow shopper with a sticker, I’ll give a little thumbs up from across the produce section. I’ve even been known to shout, “I like your sticker!” to a stranger as they pass on the sidewalk. And, Peter, if I see you out at a bar and you have your sticker on — game over. Next round on me. Voting feels good — we should celebrate our democracy. But right now, we also have to do everything we can to PROTECT it. And this year that means more than just voting. Extreme MAGA Republicans pose a critical threat to our democracy. They are actively undermining redistricting reforms, electing Election Deniers, and threatening mid-decade map redraws. = I believe, as I know you do, that this democracy is worth standing up for. The State Party will provide the most important fact - a kernel of truth - from the week. ** The Final Countdown to Election Day is Here Election Day is Tuesday! Tomorrow, Saturday, November 2, every county in Indiana will have early voting opportunities. Check on to find times + locations near you, and then get out and vote! For those waiting to cast their vote in Indiana, please note that polls will be open 6 am-6 pm local time throughout the state. Please save our voter protection number: 833-336-8683, and share with friends and family. = McCray Wins Debate On Tuesday, October 29, Indiana U.S. Senate candidates Democrat Valerie McCray and Libertarian Andrew Horning took the debate stage in their first and only debate of this election cycle — but someone was missing. Republican incumbent Jim Banks, who has run an extremely quiet race, refused to show up. During the debate itself, McCray made it known that she stands with women, and that she is prepared to ensure social security access remains equitable and affordable. Remember, your vote is your voice, so make sure you use yours. He would defend his supporters, and witch hunt, demonize, and target everyone else. **Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. Indiana Democrats are fighting across the state to ensure that Hoosiers know the truth: moving forward means there’s no room to go back. That’s why Democratic state candidates like Michelle Higgs (D-60) devised the , a program to mobilize country Dems in an effort to build a more competitive base beyond the streets of Indianapolis. The summit covers 34% of the state, and connects about a third of Indiana’s counties together. Another Democratic candidate with a strong rural presence is LG candidate Terry Goodin. A farmer by nature and a politician by trade, he understands the issues Hoosier farmers are facing — and he’s ready to address them when he and Jenifer McCormick are elected next week. **** Ross Thomas is running to represent all Hoosiers working, playing, and living in Indiana’s 59th District. He is a small business owner, attorney, husband, father, and youth baseball coach. # Last Days To Vote!
---
| We are counting down the days until the final votes are counted but I wanted to remind everyone to vote and if you can vote early. We are expecting big turnout and I plan to be out there helping our candidates win. If you live in Hendricks County, I will be out with my friends Former Sheriff Brett Clarke running for state Senate and Rep. Becky Cash running for reelection.
---
|
---
| I wanted to thank you all for these last 2 years. It has truly been a blessing to be in the state house and I am looking forward to another 2 years as your state representative with your continued support.
---
|
---
| I also wanted to include a few travel updates as well. I had the honor to speak the Monticello Fire Fighters Union recently and learned about the state of the art systems they have in place that we can learn from and bring to other counties as well.
---
|
---
| Well I was there I also was given the great opportunity by White County Chair Shannon Mattix to address the White County GOP and meet with their local leaders. A group that is very welcoming and treats everyone like family. I know I will look to being back up there soon.
---
| Finally I wanted to remind you to like, share, and check out our website and social media pages to learn more about what we are doing.
---

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96357379/509734739/824180983?refcode=ea.e8d253be-9098-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.e8d253be-9098-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU4ZDI1M2JlLTkwOTgtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0bUx43nurg4_FmHda4_EKOmAswU7JMf4IaedlTID91I=) Hi — After weeks of traveling across the country — fundraising for Vice President Kamala Harris, rallying support for our JanePAC-endorsed climate champions, and speaking to voters about what’s truly at stake in this election — I’m finally back home in California, just in time for the final stretch. On the ground this past month, I met people who are fired up and ready to elect leaders who are prepared to use every power available to address the climate crisis. Every state brought unforgettable moments, each one a reminder that our future is worth fighting for. In Washington State, I joined volunteers fighting a Big Oil-backed initiative that could strip away crucial environmental protections. In the battleground state of Arizona, I went door-to-door to support candidates for local office and reminded folks what’s at stake if Donald Trump and his allies down-ballot win. And in Michigan, I talked to voters face-to-face and shared a hug with a woman who answered the door with tears in her eyes. We talked about why this election matters so deeply, and it reminded me exactly why I’m in this fight. The hope and energy out there are _real,_ and it’s kept me going through this whirlwind election season. YOU have kept me going. **[As a small way of saying thank you, I’d like to send a couple of signed postcards from my journey after Election Day. If you can chip in to this email — even just $5 — you might find one in your mailbox as a token of my gratitude.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96357380/509734740/824180983?amount=5&refcode=ea.e8d253be-9098-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.e8d253be-9098-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU4ZDI1M2JlLTkwOTgtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0bUx43nurg4_FmHda4_EKOmAswU7JMf4IaedlTID91I=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | [**DONATE $5**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96357381/509734741/824180983?express_lane=true&amount=5&refcode=ea.e8d253be-9098-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.e8d253be-9098-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU4ZDI1M2JlLTkwOTgtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0bUx43nurg4_FmHda4_EKOmAswU7JMf4IaedlTID91I=) | [**DONATE $25**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96357382/509734742/824180983?express_lane=true&amount=25&refcode=ea.e8d253be-9098-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.e8d253be-9098-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU4ZDI1M2JlLTkwOTgtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0bUx43nurg4_FmHda4_EKOmAswU7JMf4IaedlTID91I=)

body:
Join us in making this festival of lights truly historic.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20241101-4478-footer&t=1&akid=4478%2E420207%2EstGsbt)
Peter,
This week, South Asians across the world are celebrating Diwali, a festival that speaks to the deepest hopes of our community. Also known as the Festival of Lights, it’s a moment of illumination, of connection, and of profound possibility.
And this year, it just so happens to coincide with an election in which we’ll have the chance to elect the first-ever South Asian as President of the United States.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241101-2?refcode=em20241101-4478&refcode2=4478_420207_stGsbt&akid=4478%2E420207%2EstGsbt)
On election night in 2016, Kamala Harris and I broke barriers together. I became the first South Asian woman ever elected to the House of Representatives, and she became the first South Asian woman ever elected to the Senate.
Now we stand at the brink of an even more transformative moment. It’s not just a political milestone. It's a testament to the journey of generations of people who have worked, dreamed, and persevered to get us to this moment.
Our community's story is one of resilience — of voices that refuse to be dimmed and of traditions that continue to shine brightly across continents. We see this in the vibrant celebrations happening in homes and communities across the nation. In the glow of clay lamps, in the warmth of shared meals, in the sparkle of joy that connects us.
To our diverse South Asian community — Hindus, Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Jains — this is a moment to honor our collective strength. To recognize the challenges we face, the fears that sometimes shadow our experiences, and also the power we have to uplift, to support, and to create meaningful change.
As we gather with family and friends, let us recommit ourselves to a future of true belonging. Where every voice matters, where every story is heard, where our collective light can transform our shared landscape.
[**If you’re with us in the fight to build that future, consider splitting a donation between my campaign and Kamala Harris today. We need your support to get out the vote and elect the first South Asian president on Tuesday.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241101-2?refcode=em20241101-4478amount=3&refcode2=4478_420207_stGsbt&akid=4478%2E420207%2EstGsbt)
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241101-2?amount=3&refcode=em20241101-4478&refcode2=4478_420207_stGsbt&akid=4478%2E420207%2EstGsbt)**
From my home to yours, Happy Diwali, Peter.
With hope and solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

##
Dear Friend,

Tonight, we’re making the final push together to cross the finish line! I want to personally invite you to join me for [our last major fundraising event](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=a4cac5e3d9&e=6679001ba0) of the season. We’ll be gathering from 5:30 – 7:30 PM at the home of Stephen Routh, located at 12200 Lilac Drive in Anchorage.

Every conversation, every handshake, and every bit of support you bring tonight fuels our mission for a better future for Alaska. This is the final stretch, and I couldn’t be more grateful for friends like you who stand with us and believe in our vision. Bring a friend (or two!) and come ready for a great evening with fellow supporters who care deeply about Alaska’s future.

Thank you for everything you’ve done so far. Let’s make tonight one for the books – together, we’ll secure the resources and support needed to bring this campaign home.

Looking forward to seeing you tonight!

Warm regards,

Nick Begich

| | | | |
---
| [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/a211ea079d29/im-running-and-i-need-your-support-12716613?e=8c80cba7e7)
---
[](https://voteshaffer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5a4998b6ce4b01517c474232e&id=01b9c0bfb9&e=8c80cba7e7)
| | | | | Dear ,
The weather might beg to differ, but November is here and election day is just 4 days away. Exercising your right to vote is the cornerstone of our democracy, and being involved in the democratic process at every level is equally important. I know your contributions to this election extend far beyond just casting a ballot, which is why I want to extend my heartfelt gratitude to all the volunteers, supporters, and donors who have powered our campaign. To put all this hard work into perspective, just last week, I delivered over 7,000 handwritten postcards to the post office, and in total, our campaign has sent out more than 50,000 hand-addressed letters and postcards.
Reflecting back, I am truly inspired by the remarkable support we’ve received from Republicans, Democrats, and Independents as I seek to represent all of us in District 28.

Growing up in a small town like Butte, Nebraska, you learn to take care of each other.
The family down the road may not think, pray, or love like you, but they are your neighbors and you look out for them.
Now we know that Donald Trump, JD Vance, and MAGA Republicans have a different vision of America. When they talk about freedom they mean the government should have the freedom to invade every corner of our life. Take it from a small-town guy: they know nothing about what working people need.
**That's not what we do in Minnesota.** We don’t attack our neighbors’ rights. We welcome everyone in, and we lift each other up.
My friend Tina Smith understands this. And she works hard every day to ensure Minnesotans’ voices are heard in the United States Senate.
That’s what this campaign is about: working together to build a future where everyone has the opportunity not just to get by, but to get ahead. Where workers come first, health care and housing are human rights, and the government stays the hell out of your bedroom.

body:
